| Peter,

Standing with labor isn’t just a slogan for me — it’s a deeply ingrained value that has shaped my life and career.

Raised by a single father, I spent much of my childhood after school at the city hall and fire hall where he worked, watching firefighters and public servants work tirelessly to help our community.

As Commissioner of Public Lands, I've made it my mission to honor these principles and fight every day for the rights of workers across our state – from boosting apprenticeship programs, to requiring Project Labor Agreements on clean energy projects for the first time ever, to standing with workers by securing Peace Labor Clauses at their request.

That dedication has led local unions from every corner of the district to stand with me in the race to serve as our next member of Congress.__**I’m so honored to have more labor endorsements than any non-incumbent congressional candidate in the entire country.**__ In Congress, I will work every day to pass the PRO Act and level the playing field for all workers.

clean_body: I’m so honored to have more labor endorsements than any non-incumbent congressional candidate in the entire country | = | Peter, Standing with labor isn’t just a slogan for me — it’s a deeply ingrained value that has shaped my life and career. Raised by a single father, I spent much of my childhood after school at the city hall and fire hall where he worked, watching firefighters and public servants work tirelessly to help our community. As Commissioner of Public Lands, I've made it my mission to honor these principles and fight every day for the rights of workers across our state – from boosting apprenticeship programs, to requiring Project Labor Agreements on clean energy projects for the first time ever, to standing with workers by securing Peace Labor Clauses at their request. That dedication has led local unions from every corner of the district to stand with me in the race to serve as our next member of Congress.I’m so honored to have more labor endorsements than any non-incumbent congressional candidate in the entire country. **With Joe Manchin’s retirement taking West Virginia’s Senate race off the board, our Senate race here in Missouri is the perfect candidate to replace it.**
So in a moment, **[I’m going to ask you to join me in supporting Lucas Kunce’s campaign to defeat Josh Hawley.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50290?refcode=em20240515-5526&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5526%2E614464%2EiYNKXL)** But first, please let me explain why I know Lucas has what it takes to flip this Senate seat:

---
If you’ve followed election coverage over the last year or so, the pundits might lead you to believe something new is happening.
Despite high disapproval for President Joe Biden in red states like Kentucky and Mississippi, Democrats outperformed their party’s presidential margin in statewide races by double digits. And after Republican-dominated legislatures passed extreme abortion bans in red states like Kansas and Ohio, voters delivered huge wins for reproductive rights and democracy.
But the truth is, this isn’t all that new. While pundits and insiders increasingly divide us into columns of red and blue based on their one-dimensional view of politics, voters continue to confound their expectations in election after election.
Missouri is a great example. While our state has shifted solidly red in presidential preferences since 2012, Democrats have won a half-dozen statewide campaigns, even as recently as 2018. And when Missouri politicians have adopted extreme positions on issues such as abortion, workers’ rights or health care, they’ve often seen their out-of-touch agendas soundly rejected by voters.
**Just like voters in states where we’ve seen big wins for Democrats and pro-freedom initiatives in the past year, hundreds of thousands of voters in Missouri are still splitting their tickets.**
I know this more than most because I’ve lived it. I won a race for Missouri Secretary of State. And in 2016, Missouri’s last Senate race to take place during a presidential election, I fell just 2.8% short of defeating a longtime Republican incumbent for U.S. Senate. And I outperformed the Democratic presidential ticket’s margin by more than 16%.
We proved that in races where well-funded candidates can set themselves apart and make it clear to voters that they’ll fight for them in office, Democrats can win in Missouri.
That’s what we’re seeing in Missouri’s current U.S. Senate race, as my friend Lucas Kunce takes on incumbent Josh Hawley. Much like my race in 2016, 2024 pits a labor-backed veteran against a politician — _except my opponent never tried to overthrow the government violently just to get his name out there._
Now up for reelection in 2024, Hawley faces Lucas, a Marine veteran and antitrust advocate who’s broken fundraising records, rallied Missouri’s election-winning labor movement behind him and built a reputation as a different kind of Democrat who speaks truth to power, regardless of party.
**[I’m proud to support Lucas Kunce in his race against Josh Hawley and I hope you’ll join me by adding a donation of $10 or whatever you’re able to today. Multiple polls have already confirmed that this will be a tight race, so your early support could be what helps Lucas tip the scales.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50290?refcode=em20240515-5526&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=5526%2E614464%2EiYNKXL)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50291?refcode=em20240515-5526&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=11&akid=5526%2E614464%2EiYNKXL) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50291?refcode=em20240515-5526&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=12&akid=5526%2E614464%2EiYNKXL) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50291?refcode=em20240515-5526&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=13&akid=5526%2E614464%2EiYNKXL) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50291?refcode=em20240515-5526&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=14&akid=5526%2E614464%2EiYNKXL) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50291?refcode=em20240515-5526&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=15&akid=5526%2E614464%2EiYNKXL) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50291?refcode=em20240515-5526&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=16&akid=5526%2E614464%2EiYNKXL) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50290?refcode=em20240515-5526&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=17&akid=5526%2E614464%2EiYNKXL)
---
**Now let’s talk about why Josh Hawley is so vulnerable.**
Hawley famously popped popcorn in his dorm room to gleefully watch the invasion of Iraq and then claimed a decade later to have opposed the war.
And since he’s represented Missouri in the U.S. Senate, he’s also become known as a desperately anti-union scab who is self-consciously obsessed with manhood.
From blocking defense nominations to voting against health care for veterans exposed to burn pits, Hawley has put his personal politics ahead of national security and the needs of military families. And he’s used his office to build a family business dedicated to restricting abortion access nationwide as his allies in Jefferson City enacted one of the nation’s most extreme abortion bans.
**Now with five years under Hawley’s belt in the U.S. Senate, Missourians don’t like what they’ve seen.**
Approval polling from _Morning Consult_ shows that Hawley has the lowest approval of any GOP senator running for reelection in 2024, lower than Sens. Ted Cruz of Texas and Rick Scott of Florida. And even his mentor, Missouri’s former U.S. Sen. John Danforth, has called backing Hawley the _“worst mistake I ever made.”_
Donald Trump recently commented on Hawley’s race too — _“So interesting that the Democrats are looking hard at the Senate races in both Missouri and Texas. Josh and Ted must be very careful, stranger things have happened!!!”_
**Hawley is vulnerable, and everyone knows it.** The proof is in his rapidly changing election-season rhetoric, Republicans in Washington fretting about their draconian abortion bans across the country, and Hawley’s billionaire allies launching a new pro-Hawley super PAC right after Lucas entered the race.
**[FIGHT BACK: ELECT LUCAS KUNCE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50290?refcode=em20240515-5526&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=18&akid=5526%2E614464%2EiYNKXL)**
Just as we saw in elections across the country — both last year and in the last decade — pundits and presidential politics won’t be deciding the result of every race in 2024. Voters will be.
**That’s why I’m confident that Lucas Kunce can defeat Josh Hawley.**
And with so much at stake in this election — reproductive freedom, health care access, and even our democracy — this race must be a priority.
That’s why I’m asking you today, Peter:

This is one of our best and only opportunities to flip a GOP-held Senate seat in 2024, so I hope you’ll consider adding a donation of $10 or whatever you can afford toward Lucas’ campaign today.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50290?refcode=em20240515-5526&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=19&akid=5526%2E614464%2EiYNKXL)**

Jason Kander

We proved that in races where well-funded candidates can set themselves apart and make it clear to voters that they’ll fight for them in office, Democrats can win in Missouri. That’s what we’re seeing in Missouri’s current U.S. Senate race, as my friend Lucas Kunce takes on incumbent Josh Hawley. Much like my race in 2016, 2024 pits a labor-backed veteran against a politician — except my opponent never tried to overthrow the government violently just to get his name out there. Now up for reelection in 2024, Hawley faces Lucas, a Marine veteran and antitrust advocate who’s broken fundraising records, rallied Missouri’s election-winning labor movement behind him and built a reputation as a different kind of Democrat who speaks truth to power, regardless of party. If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: Now let’s talk about why Josh Hawley is so vulnerable. Hawley famously popped popcorn in his dorm room to gleefully watch the invasion of Iraq and then claimed a decade later to have opposed the war. And since he’s represented Missouri in the U.S. Senate, he’s also become known as a desperately anti-union scab who is self-consciously obsessed with manhood. From blocking defense nominations to voting against health care for veterans exposed to burn pits, Hawley has put his personal politics ahead of national security and the needs of military families. And he’s used his office to build a family business dedicated to restricting abortion access nationwide as his allies in Jefferson City enacted one of the nation’s most extreme abortion bans. Now with five years under Hawley’s belt in the U.S. Senate, Missourians don’t like what they’ve seen. Friend,
**With the GOP prepared to invest millions of dollars into flipping New York red, I’ve set an ambitious $75,000 mid-month goal.**
I rely on donations from grassroots supporters like you to hit these goals — not corporate PACs. That’s why I’m about to ask you to make a donation to help me meet this critical mid-month goal. **[_(If you’re ready to give now, you can chip in here.)_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85032686/473433554/-862660935?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk5038-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YWU1ZDQwOC0xYTEzLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lOZoRBNmCbmCKIqhxSIlEOy7wzeeF4CT1QBpPFABCow=)**

Thank you for having my back as I lead the fight to protect **Social Security and Medicare** and ensure that seniors can retire in dignity.

Thank you for proudly standing with me in my fight to **certify the Equal Rights Amendment.** Today, we’re so close to finally establishing gender equality in our Constitution — giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights.

subject: I’m the Democratic nominee in Maryland!

body:
| Folks, it’s official: I just won the Maryland U.S. Senate Democratic primary and will be taking on Republican Larry Hogan in November.

Make no mistake, Larry Hogan won’t be easy to beat. He was handpicked by Mitch McConnell and his MAGA allies have already started pouring in millions of dollars to defeat me.

**The GOP’s plan to take back the Senate majority hinges on Maryland.** That’s why I need your help stopping them starting right now.

[**My team has a 10,000 General Election Founding Donor Goal that we must hit within the next week to have the resources to start the general on the right foot. Will you chip in a split grassroots donation right now between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project to become a General Election Founding Donor?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/67966?t=6&akid=14536%2E878179%2EyKIsnE) | [RUSH A DONATION »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/67966?t=7&akid=14536%2E878179%2EyKIsnE)
---
As Prince George’s County Executive and a former state’s attorney, I’ve spent my career fighting on behalf of Maryland families. In the Senate, I’ll be a strong voice in support of abortion rights, equality, education, and economic opportunity.

But, my Republican opponent Larry Hogan? He’s working against our Maryland values.

As Governor, he vetoed a $15 minimum wage, common sense gun legislation, and access to increased reproductive and abortion care in Maryland.

On the campaign trail, he has continually flip-flopped on the issues because he’s afraid to stand up to his party. He’s even called access to reproductive care an “emotional issue for women”.

The simple truth is this: Mitch McConnell is banking on flipping this seat and using Hogan’s vote to pass a national abortion ban, destroy Social Security and Medicare, and give tax breaks to MAGA big money donors.

I look forward to making sure every Maryland voter knows just how dangerous Larry Hogan would be in the U.S. Senate. But, we need resources immediately to start putting his feet to the fire.

[**We just have 6 months to win this race, so we need your help ASAP. Will you split a donation of $25 between the Voter Protection Project and my campaign to become a General Election Founding Donor and defeat Republican Larry Hogan in November?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/67966?t=8&akid=14536%2E878179%2EyKIsnE)

Kennedy will discuss his plans to restore the middle class, unravel corporate capture of our government agencies, unwind the war machine, end the chronic disease epidemic, reduce the national debt, make homes affordable again, and protect our constitutional rights. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- The RFK Jr. campaign turned in 245,572 signatures — twice as many as are required — to gain ballot access in Texas.An incredible milestone for the campaign. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- The Kennedy-Shanahan ticket has now secured ballot access in four states – Utah, Michigan, California, and Delaware. This significant milestone underscores the campaign's growing support and organizational strength. As the Kennedy campaign continues to collect signatures and navigate the ballot access process nationwide, it's becoming clear that this independent bid for the White House is a force to be reckoned with. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- Retired Bronco Kenny Peterson and Julianne Kennedy are proud to host a special event at a private venue in Castle Rock, CO.Saturday, May 18, 2024Please support Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. at an in-person fundraising event to support his candidacy for President of the United States. The private reception will include hors d’ oeuvres and cocktails, a fireside chat, Q&A with the candidate and a photo opportunity. This is a wonderful opportunity to meet Mr. Kennedy and ask your questions. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- | Shape Tomorrow with RFK Jr: Your Voice, Your Vote Contribute to a brighter future through action:🗳️ Secure ballot access for RFK Jr across the nation.💡 Volunteer for a campaign that represents your values.🌍 Build a more inclusive, united future together.🤝 Join forces with fellow advocates in your community.🎉 Be part of a movement that fights for all Americans. | | | In a massive poll of 26,408 likely voters conducted by John Zogby Strategies, Robert F. Kennedy Jr. emerges as the candidate best positioned to win the White House in 2024. The survey, which measured voter preferences in all 50 states to determine the electoral vote count, shows Kennedy defeating both President Joe Biden and former President Donald Trump by significant margins.Key Points: The poll suggests that Biden, not Kennedy, is the real "spoiler" in the race, as his presence gives Trump the victory. With a sample size of over 26,000, the poll has an extraordinarily low margin of error of just 0.6%. The campaign argues that this 50-state poll provides the most accurate picture of the race by measuring the electoral vote count. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- In a democracy, the free exchange of ideas is essential – especially during an election cycle. But the recent censorship of a documentary about Bobby Kennedy on social media platforms like Facebook and Instagram suggests that this fundamental principle is under threat.To ensure a fair and open political process, we must hold tech giants accountable and prevent them from suppressing content based on political bias or pressure from the government.Why It Matters:** The censorship of the Bobby Kennedy documentary on social media is not an isolated incident – it's part of a disturbing trend of tech giants and government entities collaborating to suppress certain viewpoints and control the flow of information.This kind of interference poses a direct threat to the integrity of the 2024 election and the fundamental principles of free speech and open debate that are essential to a functioning democracy. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- Please support Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. at an in-person fundraising event to support his candidacy for President of the United States. Come take a selfie with Jessica Sutta of The Pussycat Dolls and Instagram sensation Jessica Reed Kraus | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- What really led to the war in Ukraine? While media narratives often focus on the actions of individual leaders like Putin and Zelensky, a deeper look at the historical context reveals a complex web of broken promises, strategic missteps, and missed opportunities for diplomacy.Robert F. Kennedy Jr. explores the role of NATO expansion, U.S. foreign policy, and the failure of key figures to prioritize negotiation in the lead-up to the conflict. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- For too long, the United States government has neglected its obligations to Native American communities, breaking treaties, stealing land, and suppressing tribal sovereignty. Addressing these injustices will require a fundamental shift in the relationship between the federal government and Indigenous nations.Under a Kennedy administration, that shift would begin with a commitment to honoring treaties, respecting the right of self-determination, and working in partnership with tribal leaders to address issues like land restoration, resource protection, and cultural renewal. By raising Native American concerns to matters of national interest and working to prevent current and future injustices, Kennedy believes we can begin to heal the wounds of the past and build a more just and equitable future for all. | | | ---|--- | []() | ---|--- | ---|--- Copyright © 2024 KENNEDY24. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: look what they can do!
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

These wonderful canvassers are never going to be the focal point of the media’s story.

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-goykx-duchtdja-y/) But if the Pro-Life Movement manages to STOP the Abortion Lobby and their pet politicians this November, our canvassers’ work – **_all made possible by the generosity of good folks like you_ – will be a BIG PART of the reason why.**

Frankly, we push our Pro-Life Canvassers to the max trying to knock on as many doors as possible in key districts across the country.

They travel non-stop across states canvassing, engaging with voters, having conversations, leading text messaging, phone banks, and media campaigns, and registering pro-life voters . . .

They have bruised knuckles from knocking on doors, blisters from walking neighborhoods, and stories of being accosted by angry pro-abortion radicals they’ve run into.

But these courageous young women and men don’t mind.

They realize how important 2024 is.

They know their efforts today through November will result in more precious lives being saved from the violence of abortion.

**[Pro-Life Friend, will you please prayerfully consider sending a PRO-LIFE CARE PACKAGE to one of our student canvassers to encourage them as the battle for Life heats up in 2024](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-goykx-duchtdja-j/)?**

Our team of Pro-Life Canvassers are the backbone of our 2024 efforts.

It would be a lot easier if we just ran broadcast TV ads like all the high-paid political consultants say you “have to do.”

**But the truth is, we know the best way to change hearts and minds – and convert Pro-Life First voters is with one-on-one conversations.**

Not only are these conversations critical to converting voters and driving pro-life turnout in November, but they’re also shifting the larger cultural battle – one we cannot ignore if we want to make abortion illegal and unthinkable.

Thankfully, _Students for Life Action_ is hard at work with several canvasser deployments already scheduled across the country!

We just wrapped up successful door knocking in Arizona and Pennsylvania, but we’ll also be in key battleground districts in:

**●** West Virginia **●** South Carolina **●** Iowa **●** Florida **●** Virginia **●** Oklahoma **●** And many more states in the lead up to November!
It’s so crucial that we support our volunteer canvassers the best we can.

These young men and women are on the front lines every day putting in late nights of driving or making calls, having doors slammed in their faces, and even being harassed and attacked by pro-abortion radicals.

And they do it willingly! All to find the voters who are receptive to our message.

**[So, your contribution of even $25 for a hot pizza that our canvassers can enjoy after a long day, would be greatly appreciated](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-goykx-duchtdja-i/).**

But what I’d really like to do is send them a whole care package to keep them going.

Something that says, _“Thanks for all your hard work, and God bless you!”_

A **[Care Package Gift of $100](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-goykx-duchtdja-d/)** can provide the door-knocking materials they need like _Students for Life Action_ shirts, flyers, postcards, markers, and more!

And a **[Care Package Gift of $50](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-goykx-duchtdja-h/)** can pay for a tank of gas for a canvasser’s day of driving to and from strategic locations.

But, if you’d be willing to provide one canvasser with all the materials, gas, and meals they’ll need while they volunteer for us – _a whole care package_ – **[a generous Care Package Gift of $250 would accomplish that](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-goykx-duchtdja-k/).**

It’s clear the Abortion Lobby thinks they already have 2024 in the bag.

And they certainly don’t hide the fact that it’s the tainted millions they make from their bloody “business” that makes them so certain – _not to mention the $600+ million in tax-payer funding they rake in every year._

When you look at the financial numbers, this certainly is a David vs. Goliath battle.

But you and I both know how that story ended.

I have a secret weapon that has **_PROVEN_** to defeat the Abortion Lobby time and again – and I want to share our secret weapon with you . . .

It’s you, Pro-Life Friend.

It’s you and countless other pro-lifers – _like our dedicated canvassers_ – who, through their time, talent, and treasure, help _Students for Life Action_ continue to exceed the Abortion Lobby in support!

Just look at what we did with _Roe v. Wade._

It’s sitting on the ash heap of history now.

And we couldn’t have done it without the decades of hard work from our volunteers – all of whom are supported by the generosity of good folks like you.

**[So, please consider making your most generous Care Package Gift of $250, $100, $50, or even $25 to _Students for Life Action_ right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-goykx-duchtdja-u/).**

Thank you for everything you do for Life!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. – _Students for Life Action_ has been on the front lines waging a battle to protect the sanctity of Life.

Thanks to the efforts of pur Pro-Life Canvassers in key districts nationwide, we’re able to convert pro-abortion voters to the Pro-Life Movement just by knocking on their door!

**[Will you consider sending a canvasser, like the ones pictured above, a Care Package Gift to encourage them to keep fighting](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-goykx-duchtdja-o/)?**

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

Fellow Conservative,

I’m unsure if you’re aware, but tomorrow marks the final FEC fundraising deadline ahead of Montana’s June 4th primary. And quite frankly, I hoped to be in a better spot.

Because getting dollars in the door this month has been tough. My finance team tells me it’s typical for fundraising to begin taking off as Election Day draws nearer, but that hasn’t happened for us. For a while, things seem to be sorting themselves out. We raised a decent amount of money in March and April, but once May rolled around, our numbers went downhill.

---
| | Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don't know his full story--especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons.

King David's momentous story provides profound insights into many of life's most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **" The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King"** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David's character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel.

body:
In this eleven-lecture course, Dr. Kevin Slack, associate professor of politics at Hillsdale College, examines the transformation in American politics since World War II.

| | | This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zeq4gjmf1d19rrhn9kdn3f4f5fhql8oktrsjr0rg_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c3imcor0s1h2bs)

I am excited to announce that Hillsdale's online course, ["The American Left: From Liberalism to Despotism,"](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvob4ptubtis4an1rtesspcr9nsh61nnqp61bfk0_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c3imcor0s1h2bs) is now available to own on DVD.

In this eleven-lecture course, Dr. Kevin Slack, associate professor of politics at Hillsdale College, examines the transformation in American politics since World War II.

He explains the origins of 1960s radicalism and its rejection of midcentury liberalism; he reveals how these radicals came to dominate government and the universities beginning in the late 1970s; and he explores the rise of a neoliberal oligarchy in America and that oligarchy's alliance with the cultural Left in President Obama's second term.

This course seeks to understand the key people, ideas, and aims of the modern Left and to provide solutions for defending the American way of life today.

Will you partner with us to promote this free online course and expand other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty? As a token of our appreciation for your support, we'll send you the DVD Box Set of the course for a gift of $100 or more.

| | Dear Fellow American, Perhaps no statesman has displayed more courage in the face of tyranny than Winston Churchill. Not only did he diagnose the threat of modern technology, but he also spoke most effectively against the idea of socialism. So, it should come as no surprise to learn that so many “academics” and activists are working to smear Churchill’s legacy. That’s why studying an accurate account of his accomplishments is more important than ever. And right now, you can do just that when you get a copy of one of Hillsdale College’s most popular online courses, [**“Winston Churchill and Statesmanship,”**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z835l8d7eifpv4i2a76n2lrens18dad37957d8jo_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c3imeoj2cdh2bs) on DVD.
---
| | Thousands of people have enjoyed this in-depth course online since its release, **and now you can add it to your personal library or give it as a gift.** When you view this close study of Churchill’s words and deeds, you’ll learn timeless lessons that teach:
* The principles and virtues required for great statesmanship.
* How to deal with the threats and opportunities presented by modern technology.
* How to confront the threat of socialism.
* How to serve the cause of our own country as it appears today.

**I am so excited to offer you this powerful DVD set. And it can be yours today when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**

name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: Lessons in Statesmanship
body:
Perhaps no statesman has displayed more courage in the face of tyranny than Winston Churchill.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/-LxW6wDJ3s1uwWtm1I9vnw~~/AARclAA~)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, Perhaps no statesman has displayed more courage in the face of tyranny than Winston Churchill. Not only did he diagnose the threat of modern technology, but he also spoke most effectively against the idea of socialism. So, it should come as no surprise to learn that so many “academics” and activists are working to smear Churchill’s legacy. That’s why studying an accurate account of his accomplishments is more important than ever. And right now, you can do just that when you get a copy of one of Hillsdale College’s most popular online courses, [**“Winston Churchill and Statesmanship,”**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/-LxW6wDJ3s1uwWtm1I9vnw~~/AARclAA~) on DVD.
---
| | Thousands of people have enjoyed this in-depth course online since its release, **and now you can add it to your personal library or give it as a gift.** When you view this close study of Churchill’s words and deeds, you’ll learn timeless lessons that teach:
* The principles and virtues required for great statesmanship.
* How to deal with the threats and opportunities presented by modern technology.
* How to confront the threat of socialism.
* How to serve the cause of our own country as it appears today.

**I am so excited to offer you this powerful DVD set. And it can be yours today when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**
---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/-LxW6wDJ3s1uwWtm1I9vnw~~/AARclAA~)
---
| | You can reserve your copy using this secure link: _[**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/-LxW6wDJ3s1uwWtm1I9vnw~~/AARclAA~)_ As a student of Dr. Arnn myself, I know that his lectures on Churchill will teach you more about this subject than many other books and videos available today. And they will reveal profound lessons that apply to today’s urgent problems. Only a limited number of these DVD sets are available, so I hope you’ll take this opportunity to add it to your personal library or give it as a gift—before they’re gone. You can use this secure link to reserve your copy of **“Winston Churchill and Statesmanship** ” on DVD right now: _[**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/-LxW6wDJ3s1uwWtm1I9vnw~~/AARclAA~)_ Please enjoy this essential study of Churchill’s words and deeds. Best regards, Kyle Murnen, ‘09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

**Good Morning**! On this date in 1866, the U.S. Congress introduced the [modern nickel](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQgOGngc0RHHDggaGLt3TtaGFzxNdiO7KRq7x91c6df-mXvo_7eE9ceXu8p5ViK_uY5sYXja7T2IEdrcyxEAEZSVF77QIC9iCXOEHIk7MW8uSDLwEzZO-MSwpdMDlIjqDAKqdRBYfQ3yZfigl91gZ9cDMKqyhz24_b585bW6jU137RcZv3Vda4tPY8hXkTMAgYGq_0GwQM1gA6tAKGjecvql3aNr7oONPx6rRTAgZ5xPz85lr5RC-seqyJ69-3_av8CQAA__8Sf1C-) to counteract the hoarding of gold and silver coins during the Civil War. The nickel is crafted from cupronickel, an alloy of 75% copper and 25% nickel. Today is "[National Do Something Good for Your Neighbor Day](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FurDAQQNGvMR0rPJgxFC5eQ7evTYmG9RgmMp4Va23E30dJnf7qSufjvtxJspTtPx0catKFHlXevAytxRbc4poYEjNw33Cw3g4jAk7Q7MFb5zwi0GhxJT8Nvk8drchs0XKkRgJ04LrBYjcOCNNt9Sn14xRtj34cHmhcx1GqnrdPlVJ3TvnSN5-3hx5NDnutz5fp_xmYDcyFqmihXDXS9VMYmKO2Lz247lK2dlONbWHZ9lXPNtJlYG7OEJ9fkrO80BvXbQdJ_t3XP7HfAQAA__9CalYN)," and here at _The Flyover,_ we were reminded of the many random acts of kindness by our neighbors. From dog-sitting to bringing in the trash cans from the curb, good neighbors make for an even better community. ## Biden, Trump Agree to Two Debates
President Joe Biden and former President Donald Trump [agreed Wednesday to two debates](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLuu2zAQRL9G6mgsl-RSKlikcee0KQU-VvYG1AMSYyN_f6Fb33Jmijk4fx7TI0qV9fk7LhzavE0xN3nz5JQmhXayfQkzM7LpOWiv3UBII_avAM4bbcECjwDWDYYjAGU2I5Ehh70EBLTgNMHgCMdb8vNshrFoQ35wmToLXKRtx-3vJmt78Vz_b28-bnlb-hpere1nZ351eO_wHveVP-c1XeFokit3eL8uFFfOTbZV7QefUnhtEqsqnGLjU6WrUe34t-yKki66pIRcSGdPxoPVCQ0RFl_i0B-h7B-pVU7ynYXnEqV-87Qf7XwFAAD__5SZY0U), the first scheduled for June 27 on CNN, and the second on Sept. 10 on ABC. The decision to work directly with the TV networks bypasses the traditional Commission on Presidential Debates schedule, with Biden's team criticizing the commission for being "unable or unwilling to enforce the rules" during previous debates. CNN said the first debate will be held in its Atlanta studio and [no audience will be present.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O3CAURp8Gd1hwbTBTUKRxN2lTWvxcj2-EARkyVt5-NVtv81WfdI7On-f2dJQov367E23fy-ZCpzduikvNYd7mIdodEXAa0MpFKqNBP2A4LBgfUARjJh-0WLyXHqP2s4Q5gF7UQBYEzEJJLYzS8Bj9su-TeUQ56cWooNksMFIv1_i3UO4H7ul_eeM1hnIOyR6918amXwxWBut932MtiTqF8jkwWDPejcH6oTBYhWKwys94iph5vUotDRsHHtG7jo3f1A_er39n5ZF6OCi_uKfqrk7NZR7KeVJrVDIXQiojDAyXjfWmlKjphc3idTpK3379x1pfAQAA__9oW2rd) Because of the timing, Robert F. Kennedy Jr., the third-party candidate, wouldn't be on enough state ballots to qualify to participate.
## Slovakian Prime Minister Shot
Slovakian Prime Minister Robert Fico, a pro-Russian, anti-European Union populist, [was shot and gravely injured Wednesday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L9u6yAUgPGnwZstzH8GhutceUuXDh2RDYfkVMREmNrq21fp3Pk3fNL3cfXXBTNut7flAa6l4pfQ8AAv-1H1THjRRZcAGPAO3KhHaRRTlnV3F6i00upghJCBGsMFVVbLdbWRm5hSh45RJqgcFTVSMTusOiVubBy50kYGRQSFiK3U4bPg1u6Q8nc5oA6hPLrs7q09d8L_ETYTNp_nOaxreBlh8wbnTtic8YCXlZpjD1-1PKFXlo5KGU34vNfgS8UbboT_n6bLu5-mS1ddfJ6YM-5KE0FvjwXzb7L9OeAnAAD__zN6WfM) in an assassination attempt that shocked the 30-year-old Slovak Republic. Police arrested a suspect in the shooting, which occurred while Fico was greeting the public after a government meeting in Handlova, about 110 miles from the capital, Bratislava. [There's a video here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFu7CAQheGnwR2WGQPGBcVt3O1tU1osDOtJMKwArZW3jzZ1uiN9xZH-j9t-c5QoP_67E22PZXe-0wt3xYXmIHc5BBsRAecBrViEMhr0CsNhJRjjvNFRgfGzFstiJPg1mAkBUOJAFiaQkxJ6MkrDOt6XGGezBjHrxSivmZwwUC91_CyU-4ExfZcX1tGXc0j26P3Z2PyPwcZgu65rzHef8WpvZ7C95xtKTYHB1lJ5uS9ymT8rnchPytQ6Vl7LHWvnkXzh7SidV5-dUDBLM1QbnhelRE0vTE6P01H6ve9_xvgJAAD__5QOYOo) Fico, [a veteran politician,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOhCAQxvGnwU4jI4xaUFxDt9deaRCGdS64bJBbs29_8eprv_yTX_J93Zab48SP-6fbydSYF-crv2jRrcQW1KKaYCIR0NCQkaPUEwLO0GxmWFetBjn6yfezRECNgA7nqMCFSL5hAz2oXkvsJ40wd-sY4zDNQQ44TtqjUD0Frrl035kfdaOY3vlFpfN5b5LZan0eYvgQYAXY8zy7utH9x5XA7nE115pLCgKsK5V9IgH2MgXY3b0FWKmvZsstH23JK5XaRva5KSY8T06JDxyF6u-74_Sn1n8_-A0AAP__vrNcAQ) had already served as prime minister twice and was elected a third time last October as part of a deal with two other political parties. He was in surgery Wednesday in life-threatening condition.
## Netflix to Offer Christmas NFL Games
Netflix reached an agreement with the NFL Wednesday [to stream two games on Christmas Day](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L2unDAUBOCnMd1B_gEbCopsIrqbJkVK5MXHy0mMjWwHsm8fkfo2o5GmGX0_P5YPS4Hi67vdcao-LXatdOLSg9Agu6Vr3OQRJaoGJ2FEP2ipR9lsU68dcjGOSnfKG25WLw36QT5N75UYeEOT5LLjvdB86LUc26fxXg2jE0qboV816zg6qim3vxLFuqEP73Ribte0N2Haaj0KU1-YnJmcr-tq9xLvjckZI_wpTM7lSLneJfpwJ1Yf6C9Q_F3AoQ1QEzxzsm61pQLVAp5yqYAnZgh0IkQf4GV3LJAirFumUndbwNk3k7PN8HiIPW9fN6bmtJJj6tvj5sKr_MB8NHlyx0UhUNGGdfy1Wwr__9dPNf8FAAD__y0zd7I) this season and at least one game on the holiday each of the next two years. The deal, [believed to be $75 million per game](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1ugzAURp_GbEb2Nf7J4KELW7p2RDdwHVwZHJmr0Lx9lc5dvuWTjo7O13W6Yi55v3_iRpFTnXDm_KTJSu0kDNPQLTERAZmOovbaBgfuAt0a9aCc8V57JKuMTs6iM4v2JqgQFGKXIygYlNVOBevg0t98SiZcFm2cD3Z2YlC0ZK6t_65555VSedUntX6uW1fiyvw4hPkQMAoYz_Ps5_02v08B4xstYFRWwKjfsxOnkn8kV3lwI9zkWkte8CX3VOQdNzpkqk3y2ojki7Ad_cpb6VpcHmcuJR_Oi0HdN8zlz4D_7fEbAAD__zKzX6U), will give the streaming platform national broadcasting rights to the games, with the NFL providing access to broadcast TV in local team markets and on the NFL+ mobile app. Netflix has previously[ aired one-off events](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL8GNiJ8NmczMHTxlq4dLWyOcBWYyEZJ8_dVOnd-em94X9fl6jnzfvv0hVyLdfFb4wctRnWoYFgGGVwkAuoluW7szISAFmRyptd2DRGmEdCP6xYigbER4xp06O0q2YGGQZsO9WQQ7GUdY-wnG7oex8lsKAZNgVs9Lt-V95Yo5ld90HHZapHZpdbup-g_BMwC5pYocc5vJmBOtdBOz1PAXCiwFzAPiAYmq_aY1U4tZv5RgXxWWzr4bMWfKviXuvlCb00eLtyfnDOfOIpB34rnv7ps_374DQAA__8Fk17P) in tennis and golf, but the NFL games have the potential to draw both advertisers and subscribers. Dear Peter,
As I continue to make a strong showing in the polls, the other Presidential candidates are growing very nervous. In response, the other candidates either lash out at me with wild claims or coordinate with their _partners_ in social media to censor me and shadow ban me.
The other candidates know if I have equal access to the digital public square and gain ballot access in all 50 states, _I will be the candidate to beat_.
As I gain ballot access in more and more states – _like Texas just announced_ – the other candidates are using every trick in the book to stop me. But thanks to my supporters, the tricks aren’t working.
Why are they growing more and more worried?
Because I am running a campaign of ideas. It is a campaign based on the values that made us a great nation. My campaign embodies the ideals and the highest values of our nation and our people.

As President, we will rebuild our industrial base and our middle class, the backbone of our country. The entrepreneurial spirit that built our great nation will return and be rewarded under my Presidency.
This is what the American people are longing for and why I am climbing in the polls... _also why the other candidates are growing increasingly worried_.
The election is a mere six months away and we need your support to continue to build on our momentum and get our message out to every American.

# PRESS RELEASE
---
| For Immediate Release: May 16th, 2024 Contact: John Andrews John@state-local.com
---
|
---
Mike Soboleski Launches Business Owners/ Business Coalition
---
| Phillips, Maine-In a major show of support, a coalition of business owners across Maine has officially endorsed Mike Soboleski for Congress. The coalition is chaired by renowned business leader and former CD2 Republican Congressional nominee Dale Crafts. This group represents a diverse group of entrepreneurs and business professionals dedicated to fostering economic growth and stability in Maine.
"Mike Soboleski understands the challenges and opportunities facing Maine's businesses," said Dale Crafts. "His experience and dedication are what we need to ensure that our state remains a vibrant place for entrepreneurship and innovation. We are proud to support him and endorse his candidacy for Congress."
Paul Zimmerman added, "As a business owner, I recognize the importance of having leaders like Mike who grasp the realities of running a business and the impacts of federal policies on our local economies. His leadership will be invaluable in Washington."
The coalition represents a wide array of industries across Maine, from small family-owned businesses to larger enterprises, all united in their belief that Soboleski's leadership is crucial for the future of Maine's economic landscape.
"Receiving the endorsement of such a distinguished group of business leaders is a great honor," said Mike Soboleski. "This coalition not only represents the heart of Maine's economy but also highlights the shared vision we have for a prosperous future. I am committed to advocating for policies that encourage growth and provide stability for every business across our great state. Each day our support grows, and I encourage any businessowner to reach out to my team if you support the same vision."

[**Lake Wales mayor, pastor endorses James Judge for Congress**](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=fa819cceba&e=00028e5542)
LAKE WALES, Fla. – Mayor Jack Hilligoss, who is also the senior pastor of HighPoint Church in Lake Wales, endorsed James Judge in the Republican primary for Florida’s 15th Congressional District, the Judge campaign announced Thursday.
“James and I met last year, and as I have gotten to know him, it is clear to me that he is a man of principle and is driven by a Biblical worldview,” said Hilligoss. “Our government desperately needs leaders who not only believe in Biblical values, but who also fear the Lord and know that they will eventually give an account of their actions when they kneel before God, as all mankind will. I believe James has those values and that mindset, and I strongly encourage the voters of Florida’s 15th Congressional District to support and get behind his campaign.”
James thanked Hilligoss for his endorsement.
“I am blessed to be able to say that Pastor Jack has become a friend and mentor. Lake Wales is better because of Jack’s leadership and the work that the Lord is doing through HighPoint Church. Quite frankly, we need a lot more pastors like Jack,” said Judge. “Just like the Black Robed Regiment during America’s fight for independence, we need more pastors to step up and get involved in politics today.”
Hilligoss joins a growing list of strong conservative endorsements Judge has picked up since he answered President Donald Trump’s call for a MAGA conservative to challenge Rep. Laurel Lee (R-FL) in March.
Just last week, Roger Stone, a top advisor to Trump and longtime Republican strategist who has worked for nearly every Republican president since Richard Nixon, endorsed Judge.
Additionally, the national Republican Liberty Caucus, former Congressman Steve King (R-IA), former Congressman Ted Yoho (R-FL), Tampa’s conservative grassroots group Community Patriots, and Born to Ride for 45, a national motorcycle riding club with 6,000 members, have all endorsed Judge since he launched his race against Lee in March.
“In less than a year-and-a-half, Rep. Lee has demonstrated through her actions in office that she effectively votes in line with the Democrats, which is why I believe President Trump called for her removal,” said Judge. “She is not only funded by enemies of traditional Christian and conservative values, but she has also voted in favor of forcing our military servicemembers to endure indoctrination, which promotes diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI) and LGBT ideology. Furthermore, she also recently sponsored legislation supporting FISA and continuing warrantless searches of Americans. This is unacceptable for any Republican.”
According to a recent review of political contributions tracked by the Federal Election Commission, Lee has accepted hundreds of special interest contributions in her short stint as a Congresswoman, including taking funding from disgraced former House Speaker Kevin McCarthy, Meta, Facebook’s parent company, and Google, which Judge says, have a proven track record of opposing traditional conservative values.
Contrary to Lee, Judge says he is running to reduce federal spending, balance the budget, secure the border and restore law-and-order.
About James Judge:James Judge, a Florida native, graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and served in the U.S. Coast Guard in Operation Iraqi Freedom. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based public relations, marketing and consulting firm. Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner. The Judges live on a ranch in Dade City, with their dogs, cats, chickens, cows, goats and horses. Judge is a proud member of the NRA, Veterans of Foreign Wars and the American Legion. The Judges are also longtime, active members at Idlewild Baptist Church in Lutz.

_“Without God, there could be no American form of Government, nor an American way of life. Recognition of the Supreme Being is the first–the most basic–expression of Americanism. Thus the Founding Fathers saw it, and thus, with God’s help, it will continue to be.”_ – Dwight D. Eisenhower

# PRESS RELEASE
---
| For Immediate Release: May 16th, 2024 Contact: John Andrews John@state-local.com
---
|
---
Mike Soboleski Secures Paul Zimmerman's Endorsement and Unveils 'Soboleski for Congress Business Coalition
---
| Guilford, ME - In a significant boost to Mike Soboleski's congressional campaign, Paul Zimmerman and Martha Ward, prominent business owners and community leaders in Guilford, have officially endorsed Soboleski for the upcoming CD2 Republican primary. Zimmerman and Ward, known for their deep community ties and business acumen, cited the critical need for experienced leadership in Washington as a key reason for his support.
"It's essential to have leaders who understand what's at stake and have the experience to navigate through these tough times", Zimmerman stated during a press conference held at his business headquarters. "Mike Soboleski is the leader we need. His straightforward approach and proven track record of getting things done are exactly what our district and our nation require."
Soboleski's extensive background, including his service as a United States Marine, plays a crucial role in Zimmerman's endorsement. With Maine boasting one of the highest numbers of veterans per capita, Zimmerman and Ward believe Soboleski's military experience resonates well with people and adds a layer of understanding and advocacy for veteran's issues in Congress.
"I like Mike because he gets it. He understands the challenges we face as a community and as a nation, and he's prepared to tackle them head-on," Zimmerman added. "His service as a Marine is another testament to his commitment and ability to lead. For these reasons, I am proud to give Mike my full and complete endorsement."
Soboleski expressed his gratitude for Zimmerman's support, noting that such endorsements are a testament to the campaign's growing momentum and its resonance with local business leaders and the broader community.

Zimmerman and Ward, known for their deep community ties and business acumen, cited the critical need for experienced leadership in Washington as a key reason for his support. "It's essential to have leaders who understand what's at stake and have the experience to navigate through these tough times", Zimmerman stated during a press conference held at his business headquarters. "Mike Soboleski is the leader we need. His straightforward approach and proven track record of getting things done are exactly what our district and our nation require." Soboleski's extensive background, including his service as a United States Marine, plays a crucial role in Zimmerman's endorsement. With Maine boasting one of the highest numbers of veterans per capita, Zimmerman and Ward believe Soboleski's military experience resonates well with people and adds a layer of understanding and advocacy for veteran's issues in Congress. "I like Mike because he gets it. He understands the challenges we face as a community and as a nation, and he's prepared to tackle them head-on," Zimmerman added. "His service as a Marine is another testament to his commitment and ability to lead. For these reasons, I am proud to give Mike my full and complete endorsement." Soboleski expressed his gratitude for Zimmerman's support, noting that such endorsements are a testament to the campaign's growing momentum and its resonance with local business leaders and the broader community. ANCHORAGE, AK - In case you missed it, Anchorage Daily News published
an opinion piece from Frank Dahl highlighting Mary Peltola's failed
leadership as the at-large Alaska representative. Frank Dahl is the
former owner of Blues Central and a past president of the Alaska
Cabaret, Hotel, Restaurant and Retailers Association (CHARR).

In his piece, Dahl shares why it's important to put Alaska's priorities
ahead of partisan politics - something Mary Peltola has been unable to
do in her short tenure in Congress. Dahl also notes that Mary Peltola's
lack of political experience and courage has seen her side with Joe
Biden and the Democrats rather than with Alaskans, even after she ran
as an independent voice.

To top it all off, Mary Peltola voted "present" on a bill she
originally pushed, the Alaska's Right to Produce Act, showing her true
colors as a floundering Democrat career politician out of touch with
Alaskans' needs.

In closing, Dahl says, "It's time to end Mary Peltola's failed
congressional experiment and vote for Lt. Gov. Nancy Dahlstrom to
represent our state in Washington."

<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=67909&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC

subject: NY Symposium, Friday 7 pm: New York on the Belt and Road -- Revive Our Industrial Powerhouse
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sare for Senate

---
Friend -- As I've traveled across the state, I've been struck by the potential beauty of New York's formerly great industrial cities. If you take a drive through the residential areas of Buffalo, Syracuse and Albany, (among others) you see solid single-family homes, built of brick and stone, which were once inhabited by middle class families in calm neighborhoods, where children played outside and everyone knew what everyone else's kids were up to. Parents could keep track of their children because one salary from Bethlehem Steel or American Steel and Aluminum was sufficient to support a family of five or six. In today's hyperinflationary world, it's very hard to imagine being able to pay one's rent, or mortgage on one week's pay, but that can become the standard again. New York, with its important historical contribution to the American Revolution, including its economic contribution to building the infrastructure of our nation, from the Erie Canal to the West Point engineering legacy, can be the driver of a real economic and cultural recovery of our nation. Join me, and my colleague Roger Ham as we explore the past and future potential of our great state.
### [New York Symposium, May 17, 2024, 7:00 PM: New York State on the Belt and Road: Big, Beautiful Industrial Cities by 2040](https://www.sareforsenate.com/r?u=2PNlHEbVYFsh-F_FzIY8nVRZTA6fF-w3c7sq5T2YPIQ&e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240517_symposium&n=2)

clean_body: | | Friend -- As I've traveled across the state, I've been struck by the potential beauty of New York's formerly great industrial cities. If you take a drive through the residential areas of Buffalo, Syracuse and Albany, (among others) you see solid single-family homes, built of brick and stone, which were once inhabited by middle class families in calm neighborhoods, where children played outside and everyone knew what everyone else's kids were up to. Parents could keep track of their children because one salary from Bethlehem Steel or American Steel and Aluminum was sufficient to support a family of five or six. In today's hyperinflationary world, it's very hard to imagine being able to pay one's rent, or mortgage on one week's pay, but that can become the standard again. New York, with its important historical contribution to the American Revolution, including its economic contribution to building the infrastructure of our nation, from the Erie Canal to the West Point engineering legacy, can be the driver of a real economic and cultural recovery of our nation. Join me, and my colleague Roger Ham as we explore the past and future potential of our great state. | "DONATE" \--Diane | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- | Paid for by Sare for Senate

A Great American, A Great Republican
**Meet our****Frederick Douglass Awardees**

# Why Frederick Douglass?
**A Force for Uniting the United States:** Frederick Douglass serves as a powerful symbol for Republicans to promote the values and principles that make our nation unique. He was born into slavery in 1818, but later became one of the leading advocates for reuniting our nation as the Civil War came to an end. His strong conviction in the power of our founding values and constitutional principles, along with his self-learned eloquence, helped guide Abraham Lincoln and the recently formed Republican party to win a second term based on these values and principles. Lincoln faced the daunting challenge of rescuing a nation divided by the Civil War.
**Believed in American Principles:** History tells us that Lincoln's wholehearted embrace of Douglass's message of fighting for and preserving the values that formed our nation was not only the winning message, but also the roadmap for reunification. Today, as our nation becomes increasingly fragmented along political issues and divergent views of our fundamental values and principles of freedom, engaging people based on this former slave's unassailable historical contribution offers the most effective messaging for winning new hearts and minds.
**A Symbol of Republican Values:** Just as Lincoln turned to Douglass for guiding the salvation of America, Republicans can leverage Douglass as a pivotal symbol for fully realizing the greatness of our country. In a historical context, emulating Lincoln and using the impactful legacy of Frederick Douglass serves to open the door to all voters to find common ground and reunite our country.
**Frederick Douglass played a crucial role in the birth of the Republican Party:** The Republican Party was founded in 1854 by abolitionists who aimed to end slavery and advocate for the civil rights of Black people, with Frederick Douglass playing a significant role in initiating the political campaign.

# NPP in the News
**NPPEF CEO Kadida Kenner was recently quoted in The Capital B article "Voter Apathy Is Real. Here’s How Black Organizers Are Tackling It."
** “It’s probably not their fault. It’s the fact that we have groups such as [**Moms for Liberty**](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=fc53cb9531&e=95417d7e87)**** that go into schools around the U.S. and disrupt public education,” she noted, referring to the right-wing organization that since its formation in 2021 has waged war on teaching about race and identity in the classroom. “We come across young folks who haven’t received this type of learning, this type of civic engagement.”Plus, they might live in a household that doesn’t have a registered voter, and “I know that I’m a voter because I watched my mom vote,” Kenner added. Read the full article [**here**](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=09746b5fdc&e=95417d7e87).

# Courts Matter
**Nearly every county in Pennsylvania is short on public defenders, according to a new report** Pennsylvania has an insufficient number of public defenders in nearly every county, according to a new report from a University of Pennsylvania law professor, hampering the state’s ability to fulfill its constitutional obligation to provide adequate representation for criminal defendants who can’t afford a lawyer, [The Philadelphia Inquirer reports](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=8758c15054&e=95417d7e87).
**Chester County judge denies county GOP request that could have blocked some ballots** “The injunction proposed in this matter would disenfranchise and, therefore, harm voters who are unable to submit their ballots on their own,” the ruling said. [Read the full article here.](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=2a2a9ffcf6&e=95417d7e87)
**Progressives Prep $10 Million Campaign to Expose ‘MAGA Supreme Court’** Many voters don’t blame Donald Trump or Republicans for the Supreme Court’s increasingly right-wing decisions. This coalition wants to change that, [Rolling Stone reports.](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=6c5437acb3&e=95417d7e87)
# News You Can Use
**Pennsylvania to ban cell phone use while driving and require police to collect traffic stop data** Gov. Josh Shapiro’s office said Thursday that the Democrat will sign the bill, 18 years after he first introduced a similar bill when he served in the state House of Representatives, [AP reports.](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=2e9b25cbf3&e=95417d7e87)
**Pa. sees fewer mail ballots rejected for technicalities, a priority for election officials** Pennsylvania election officials said Wednesday that the rate of mail-in ballots rejected for technicalities, like a missing date, saw a significant drop in last month’s primary election after state officials tried anew to help voters avoid mistakes that might get their ballots thrown out, [AP reports](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=8ef9747766&e=95417d7e87).
**Pennsylvania Taxpayers Are Funding Discriminatory Religious Schools** Private schools can reject disabled applicants, expel LGBTQ students, and teach creationism all they want—even though hundreds of millions of public dollars flow to them every year, [The New Republic reports](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=057ad7accc&e=95417d7e87).
**Certification of Centre Co. election results on hold due to legal challenge of ballots** The final primary election results in Centre County are now on hold due to a court suit being filed over the status of close to 100 mail-in ballots, [WJAC TV reports](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=d306f63a51&e=95417d7e87).
**RNC Seeks to Defend Pennsylvania County’s Decision Not To Cure Naked Mail-in Ballots** The Republican National Committee (RNC) and Pennsylvania Republican Party (PA GOP) are stepping into a lawsuit to prevent the Butler County Board of Elections from curing ballots without a secrecy envelope, also known as “naked ballots,” [Democracy Docket reports](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=38b715e89a&e=95417d7e87).
**Lebanon officials see more residents using staffed mail-in drop point during April primary** With more Lebanon County voters taking advantage of mail-in ballots and the new-drop off site for the April 23 primary, commissioners said they have not discussed if the site will be used for the general election, [Lebanon Daily News reports.](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=c2505e9cf7&e=95417d7e87)
# Important 2024 Election Dates
**General Election** : November 5, 2024**Last day to register to vote:** October 21, 2024**Last day to request mail-in ballot** : October 29, 2024
# Help Us Expand The Electorate
**We're on a mission to register new voters in the Commonwealth and expand the electorate.**
**Help us prepare for the upcoming primary and general elections in 2024!**
[](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=aa72a7a5ae&e=95417d7e87)
The 2024 General Election is just around the corner but there is much work to be done — and we can’t do it alone! New Pennsylvania Project is on a mission to register 60,000 voters from across the Commonwealth, with a focus on reaching those from underserved and underrepresented communities. We can’t do that, however, without your continued support. If you haven’t yet, please consider clicking the button below and investing just a few dollars in these efforts.Every dollar helps us host more events, reach more people, and ultimately, register more voters ahead of this incredibly high-stakes election!
[Invest in our Democracy](https://newpaproject.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e6e5141dda36b4ba08999c131&id=6ebc779214&e=95417d7e87)

| Dear Peter, I have a family member with bipolar disorder. Our lives have been profoundly affected not just by his mental health challenges, but by our society’s broken mental health system. When things are working well, he can receive comprehensive treatment, is able to engage in healthy relationships, and finds fulfilling work and connection to the community. Too often, though, he has experienced the utter failure of our mental health system to provide needed care. Too often, I have witnessed how it adds to the hurt rather than heals. In the downward spiral of a mental health crisis, I have seen how easy it is to lose a connection to treatment and how hard it is to get back on track. At every turn, the very structure of our medical and health insurance systems makes it nearly impossible to reconnect to treatment. The criminal justice system, however, is always available and open. I have watched my family member cycle through arrests, trial dates, and jail time. I have engaged with police officers and pleaded with judges for a treatment-based outcome. Often, they agree such treatment is what is most needed, but the system can only offer a criminal response. Many more people with serious mental health conditions are behind bars in jails and prisons than are in hospitals or treatment facilities. I decided to run for public office because I felt I needed to bring the heartbreak and hope I had experienced firsthand into the policy-making arena. I want to be sure that as policy makers, we always remember and value the humanity of each individual with mental illness, their families, and fellow community members. **My Legislative Record on Mental Health**
Since I was elected in 2018, I have prioritized mental health as one of my key issues by: • Passing legislation to require mobile crisis units to minimize interactions between law enforcement and people experiencing behavioral health crises, prioritizing a mental health response that is culturally competent; • Increasing funding for mobile crisis units through grant programs for local governments; • Requiring 911 systems to develop policies to triage behavioral health crises in order to dispatch the most appropriate services; • Establishing a process for families and trusted friends to participate in the development and administration of treatment plans for individuals who are hospitalized involuntarily; • Advocating that school-based mental health services receive Medicaid reimbursement, and • Supporting funding for Takoma Park’s behavioral health response program. There is much more to do, of course, and I am already working with experts and advocates on more legislation for next year’s session. **Mental Health Resources**
Much more needs to be done to protect mental health and ensure equitable access to care for all Marylanders. Encourage the people in your life to seek help if they need it and remind them they are not alone. Help is available through the [988 Lifeline](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85042327/473477618/921653064?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZGVjNDYzMS04NDEzLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxNGRhZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fLB5ffSXpqz0POcDg_gh2sWtZepozT1nuUAfh6qfvUU=&emci=34e04ee9-ef11-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=8dec4631-8413-ef11-96f3-7c1e5214dad0&ceid=37927032), support groups, online resources, or local programs. ○ [Common Signs of Mental Health Challenges](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85042332/473477626/-34409041?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZGVjNDYzMS04NDEzLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxNGRhZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fLB5ffSXpqz0POcDg_gh2sWtZepozT1nuUAfh6qfvUU=&emci=34e04ee9-ef11-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=8dec4631-8413-ef11-96f3-7c1e5214dad0&ceid=37927032)

clean_body: | | Dear Peter, I have a family member with bipolar disorder. Our lives have been profoundly affected not just by his mental health challenges, but by our society’s broken mental health system. When things are working well, he can receive comprehensive treatment, is able to engage in healthy relationships, and finds fulfilling work and connection to the community. Too often, though, he has experienced the utter failure of our mental health system to provide needed care. Too often, I have witnessed how it adds to the hurt rather than heals. In the downward spiral of a mental health crisis, I have seen how easy it is to lose a connection to treatment and how hard it is to get back on track. At every turn, the very structure of our medical and health insurance systems makes it nearly impossible to reconnect to treatment. The criminal justice system, however, is always available and open. I have watched my family member cycle through arrests, trial dates, and jail time. I have engaged with police officers and pleaded with judges for a treatment-based outcome. Often, they agree such treatment is what is most needed, but the system can only offer a criminal response. Many more people with serious mental health conditions are behind bars in jails and prisons than are in hospitals or treatment facilities. I decided to run for public office because I felt I needed to bring the heartbreak and hope I had experienced firsthand into the policy-making arena. I want to be sure that as policy makers, we always remember and value the humanity of each individual with mental illness, their families, and fellow community members. My Legislative Record on Mental Health Since I was elected in 2018, I have prioritized mental health as one of my key issues by: • Passing legislation to require mobile crisis units to minimize interactions between law enforcement and people experiencing behavioral health crises, prioritizing a mental health response that is culturally competent; • Increasing funding for mobile crisis units through grant programs for local governments; • Requiring 911 systems to develop policies to triage behavioral health crises in order to dispatch the most appropriate services; • Establishing a process for families and trusted friends to participate in the development and administration of treatment plans for individuals who are hospitalized involuntarily; • Advocating that school-based mental health services receive Medicaid reimbursement, and • Supporting funding for Takoma Park’s behavioral health response program. There is much more to do, of course, and I am already working with experts and advocates on more legislation for next year’s session. Mental Health Resources Much more needs to be done to protect mental health and ensure equitable access to care for all Marylanders. I have long, and proudly, worked on interfaith coalition building. When extremists attacked a Jewish cemetery near my mosque in Philadelphia, I was proud to activate my mosque community to help with clean up. When I was asked to speak at the funeral of a Holocaust Survivor and serve as a pallbearer, I considered it my distinct honor. Whenever I've been invited to Seders and Synagogues to break bread or speak on interfaith harmony, I've embraced the opportunities. These moments of unity and solidarity are important to a healthy society, in significant part because unfortunately, provocateurs have long tried to drive a wedge between Muslims and Jews with varying degrees of success. _Let 's Address This._
For example, not too long ago I received this meme from a Jewish friend. They sent it not to antagonize me--quite the contrary. They sent it as a heads up and request to provide context for those who might fall victim to this dangerous misinformation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/59f7794b-bba4-41f3-b8cc-78d48cc7ab3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The meme depicts two women speaking to one another. The first woman says:
> "Isn't the Israeli Palestinian conflict just a Middle Eastern argument over land between Muslims and Jews?"
To which the second woman responds:
> "Yes, but not the first. Jewish people have lived in Jerusalem for thousands of years. And they've lived in the Middle East for ages, being oppressed, raped + murdered by the Arab Empire, like Palestinian Christians."
By the time I received this meme it had been shared thousands of times across social media, fueled by popular celebrities with large platforms. At a time of immense antisemitism and Islamophobia, such memes do nothing to advance peace and understanding, but create immense fear to advance hate and violence. It is a dangerous misrepresentation of history and creates anti-Muslim hate and antisemitic hate--not to mention the complete erasure of Palestinian Christians.
This dangerous meme is a perfect example of why I launched this platform, to combat media misinformation and uphold universal human rights, so people have a reliable, trusted source from which to glean information and set the record straight. Let's start from the beginning. In 622 C.E., the Founder of Islam, Prophet Muhammad, left Mecca after a dozen years of brutal persecution. He traveled some 220 miles by foot and arrived in Medina, a city state that was predominantly Jewish with a growing Muslim population. As part of the new government he helped establish, he ratified the landmark Constitution of Medina, sometimes known as the Charter of Medina. Established in 622, the Constitution of Medina was history's first secular Constitution. It mandated separation of religion and state and united the Muslims and Jews as one alliance. It comprised of 57 Articles, including these two gems most relevant to our discussion:
> Article 17: No Jew shall be wronged for being a Jew.
> Article 18: The enemies of the Jews who follow [Muslims] will NOT be helped.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8e9a8445-3a17-4bea-b704-8a4c09422517?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Image of Charter of Medina
The Charter went on to explicitly confirm the humanity of Jewish people as equal to Muslims (Article 42), and the obligations of Muslims to protect not only Jews, but even allies of the Jews who were not explicitly mentioned in the Charter (Article 34). This ironclad commitment would soon be put to the test as war would impose itself on Medina. Accordingly, when Medina was subsequently attacked in the following years, for example in what is now known as the Battle of the Ditch, history records that Prophet Muhammad and the Muslims actively defended Jews from attack and being killed, and protected Medina's unified sovereignty and sanctity.
Meanwhile, some 600 miles away and six years later in 629, Byzantine Christians conquered Jerusalem and forcibly expelled all Jews from this holy city. A massacre of Jews ensued. Going forward, Jews were forbidden from settling in Jerusalem and were forced, by some accounts, to live at least 3 miles outside the city walls.
This atrocity against Jews was _not_ committed by Arabs or Muslims--as they had an alliance with Jews and remained steadfast in that alliance--but by the Byzantines.
Prophet Muhammad died in 632, and his death tested whether the alliance he made with Jews, and the promise of protection of Jews from harm, would remain in tact? That question was emphatically answered in 638 when the Caliph Umar conquered Jerusalem and retook it from the Byzantine Christians. As among his first orders of business, Umar reopened Jerusalem for Jews to reenter and live peacefully and without persecution. The restrictions in movement and residency that the Byzantines had imposed upon the Jewish people were also lifted. Likewise, Christians were allowed to remain in Jerusalem provided they did not engage in war. Subsequently, Jews, Muslims, and Christians live in relative peace under Muslim rule for the next 461 years. Soak that in for a moment. The United States has only existed for 248 years. But for nearly double the existence of the United States, Jews and Christians lived peacefully under Muslim rule in Jerusalem.
That unity continued until the Crusaders retook Jerusalem from the Muslims in 1099. Horrifyingly, another massacre ensued, again not committed by Arabs or Muslims, but _of_ Muslims and _of_ Jews at the hands of the Christian Crusaders.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7a42e847-00d7-4708-a50a-7ec0c8594035?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
From 1099-1187, the First Crusaders conquered Jerusalem and committed a well documented massacre of the previous Jewish and Muslim residents of Jerusalem.
And true to the Constitution of Medina signed some 467 years prior, Jews and Muslims fought side-by-side against the invading army, but lost. Those who survived the war were once again expelled from Jerusalem altogether. That is, until 1187. In 1187, General Saladin launched a successful campaign against the Crusaders and retook Jerusalem, again.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cfb455cb-7270-488f-83fc-4108ec375ed3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And yet again, true to the covenant established more than 500 years prior, General Saladin allowed Jews to re-enter Jerusalem, a second time, just as Caliph Omar had done centuries prior. He furthermore let native Christians remain in Jerusalem and as another token of his sincerity, compassionately guarded the Holy Sepulcher of Christ from attack, vandalism, or destruction--all this contrary to the malicious allegation of "rape of Palestinian Christians." In fact, to this day in 2024, the Holy Sepulcher is honored under Muslim protection. I have had the honor of visiting the Holy Sepulcher and paying my respects personally.
Again, to emphasize the point once more, Jews and Muslims lived in relative harmony and peace without any such incidents of "rape and murder by the Arab empire."
From 1259-1516, under the Mamluk reign, there were several notable Jews and Christians in high ranking positions in the Muslim majority government of Jerusalem. To be sure, this was not a utopia by any means, but likewise, there are no such examples of "mass murder or rape" as alleged. The Mamluk reign lasted until 1517, when the Ottomans took over Jerusalem.

From 1517-1917, under 400 years of Muslim rule we once again history records relative peace and a rapid growth of the Jewish population in Jerusalem. This era amounted to the _third_ multi-century reign of Muslim leadership, in which Jews lived in Jerusalem, protected by Muslims from outside attacks, and free to practice and worship without oppression. This alone should suffice as evidence that Muslims and Jews have long lived in peace and harmony with one another.
And this harmony wasn't only in the Middle East.
Vastly contrary to the treatment of Jewish people under Christian Europe, in Moorish Spain we see 700 years of Muslim rule and relative peace between Muslims, Jews, and Christians. Indeed this was known as the Golden Age of Islam. As historian Gwendolyn Midlo Hall relates about this time period:
> The Almoravids were a country people, religious and honest...Their reign was tranquil, and was untroubled by any revolt, either in the cities, or in the country- side...Their days were happy, prosperous, and tranquil... There was no tribute, no tax, or contribution for the government except the charity tax and the tithe. Prosperity constantly grew; the population rose, and everyone could freely attend to their own affairs. Their reign was free of deceit, fraud, and revolt, and they were loved by everyone. Even after its overthrow, other chroniclers of Islamic Spain praised the rule of the Almoravids. They wrote that learning was cherished, literacy was wide-spread, scholars were subsidized, capital punishment was abolished, and their gold coins were so pure and of such reliable weight that they assured prosperity and stimulated trade throughout the Mediterranean world. Christians and Jews were tolerated within their realms. When the Christians rose up in revolt, they were not executed but were exiled to Morocco instead.
