> Your Highnesses, as Catholic Christians and Princes who love the holy Christian faith, and the propagation of it, and _who are enemies to the sect of Mahomet and to all idolatries and heresies_ , resolved to send me, Cristobal Colon, to the said parts of India to see the said princes...with a view that they might be converted to our holy faith..._Thus, after having turned out all the Jews from all your kingdoms and lordships_...your Highnesses gave orders to me that with a sufficient fleet I should go to the said parts of India...I shall forget sleep, and shall work at the business of navigation, so that the service is performed. (Borne, 1906: 76) (emphasis added)
The above attests once more that even if there were instances of conflict, Muslims and Jews lived in consistent harmony with one another, and both suffered horrific atrocity at the hands of Crusaders and genocidal maniacs like Columbus.

Returning to the main point at hand, shortly after the fall of the Ottoman Empire, the State of Israel was created in 1948. The history from 1948 to 2024 warrants an independent analysis, which perhaps I will provide at a future date. For the purposes of this article, history consistently records that from 622 to 1917--a span of nearly 1300 years--no mass or generational discrimination, rape, and murder of Jewish people existed under Muslim rule or at the hands of Muslims. On the contrary, under Muslim rule, Jewish people were consistently protected from persecution and annihilation. History records no example of Muslims proactively targeting and harming Jewish people for being Jewish--indeed the Constitution of Medina ratified by Prophet Muhammad way back in 622 specifically forbade such atrocity.
The conflict between Israel and Palestine today is due to contemporary injustice, not ancient war. It is due to political injustice, not a religious feud. The offensive but viral meme that this article debunks, and others like it, succeed only in advancing hate, racism, fear, and misinformation. Let us demand better.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3857a996-49c6-4c90-b05f-3941fb1a2448?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Demanding better begins not only with honesty about history, but also by contemporarily upholding international human rights law to ensure an immediate and permanent ceasefire, a release of all hostages on both sides, an end to the illegal military occupation and illegal settlements in Palestine, and the right for Palestine to be an independent sovereign nation with self-determination. Such a path forward will uphold justice and safety for Palestinians, justice and safety for Israelis, and a meaningful consistent standard of accountability going forward.
Doing so would truly revive the long history of mutual co-existence that Muslims and Jews initiated with the landmark Constitution of Medina in 622 C.E. And that is a unity on the tenets of justice and humanity worth fighting for.

_America is at a crossroads.
_
_**Under the disastrous leadership of Joe Biden and his radical left allies like Sherrod Brown, our economy is in shambles, with out-of-control inflation crushing everyday Americans.

Violent crime is on the rise in cities across this nation, leaving millions of innocent citizens living in fear for their lives each day.

_Fellow patriot, this is Biden’s America._ A place where hardworking Americans are left behind while career politicians like Sherrod Brown cozy up to the radical left agenda that got us here. # FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Reader, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

#

You probably already heard about that out-of-touch speech from Chiefs kicker Harrison Butker. You might not have heard that Josh Hawley is already defending it:

This guy wants to control every little thing about our lives — what we do in the workplace, in the bedroom, and in the doctor’s office. He even wants to be in charge of what we do with our own bodies.
**It’s weird. It’s creepy. And it’s sure as hell not his job.**

That’s a message that resonates with Missourians of all parties, all across the state.

| **Memorandum** TO: All Supporters
FROM: Enid Muthoni Ndiga
DATE: May 16, 2024
SUBJECT: Top 5 Priorities at the Center for Reproductive Rights
* * *
Here are the top 5 priorities this year at the Center for Reproductive Rights:
1. **Litigating Medical Exceptions in U.S. State Abortion Bans**
States that have criminalized abortion have put pregnant people in serious danger as those facing pregnancy complications are being denied medically necessary abortion care. The Center has filed legal actions in Texas, Idaho, and Tennessee to confront this inequity in care on behalf of patients and their providers.

2. **Protecting Medication Abortion Access in the U.S.**
Medication abortion is safe and effective and has been used by millions since the FDA approved it 24 years ago. As the U.S. Supreme Court prepares to issue a ruling in a case designed to upend access to abortion pills nationwide, the Center will continue to lead the fight to protect and promote access to medication abortion.

3. **Confronting the Maternal Health Crisis**
It is unacceptable that, worldwide, nearly 300,000 women die each year during pregnancy and childbirth. The Center is confronting this crisis by working to reduce maternal health disparities, improve outcomes, and hold governments accountable for their human rights obligations to patients.

4. **Ensuring Reproductive Rights as Human Rights**
It is past time that sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) be recognized as human rights. Since its founding in 1992, the Center has played a leading role in advocating for this global human right at the United Nations, to ensure all people have reproductive self-determination.

5. **Advancing Reproductive Care Globally**
The Center works to confront the root causes of systemic violations of sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) globally. We work to strengthen laws, policies, and practices that ensure human rights are respected, protected, and fulfilled.

We can't meet our audacious goals without the help of our partners. #
Friends, it’s official: I won the Maryland U.S. Senate Democratic primary and will be taking on Republican Larry Hogan in November.
Make no mistake, Larry Hogan won’t be easy to beat. He was handpicked by Mitch McConnell and his MAGA allies have already started pouring in millions of dollars to defeat me.
**The GOP’s plan to take back the Senate majority hinges on Maryland.** That’s why I need your help stopping them starting right now.
[**My team has a 10,000 General Election Founding Donor Goal that we must hit within the next week to have the resources to start the general on the right foot. Will you chip in a split grassroots donation right now between my campaign and The Long Run to become a General Election Founding Donor?**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-alsobrooks-split.edwx-i&refcode=em240516-1-tt&t=1&akid=5303%2E196590%2E9Vj0na)
[RUSH A DONATION](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-alsobrooks-split.edwx-i&refcode=em240516-1-tt&t=2&akid=5303%2E196590%2E9Vj0na)
As Prince George’s County Executive and a former state’s attorney, I’ve spent my career fighting on behalf of Maryland families. In the Senate, I’ll be a strong voice in support of abortion rights, equality, education, and economic opportunity.
But, my Republican opponent Larry Hogan? He’s working against our Maryland values.
As Governor, he vetoed a $15 minimum wage, common sense gun legislation, and access to increased reproductive and abortion care in Maryland.
On the campaign trail, he has continually flip-flopped on the issues because he’s afraid to stand up to his party. He’s even called access to reproductive care an “emotional issue for women”.
The simple truth is this: Mitch McConnell is banking on flipping this seat and using Hogan’s vote to pass a national abortion ban, destroy Social Security and Medicare, and give tax breaks to MAGA big money donors.
I look forward to making sure every Maryland voter knows just how dangerous Larry Hogan would be in the U.S. Senate. But, we need resources immediately to start putting his feet to the fire.

subject: 🗳️ Voting in primary runoffs starts NEXT WEEK / La votación en la segunda vuelta de las primarias comienza la PRÓXIMA SEMANA 🗳️
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Primary runoffs are almost here.
Get ready to VOTE!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Election%202024.png]
Building a more progressive, equitable, and inclusive Texas means electing into office people-powered champions who will help us win on the issues that affect our communities. These primary runoffs are an opportunity for us to assert our values, flex our progressive power, and have our voice heard on who we want fighting for us at the local, state, and federal level.
Early voting for the primary runoffs starts this Monday, May 20, and runs through Friday, May 24. Election Day is Tuesday, May 28.
VOTE for the following TOP-endorsed candidates who will be on the ballot in Bexar and Harris County:
• Rebeca Clay-Flores [https://rebecaclayflores.com/] for Bexar County Commissioner, Pct. 1
• Molly Cook [https://www.mollyfortexas.com/] for State Senate, Dist. 15 (Harris County)
• Lauren Ashley Simmons [https://www.laurenashleysimmons.com/] for State Representative, Dist. 146 (Harris County)
• Annette Ramirez [https://www.electannetteramirez.com/] for Tax Assessor-Collector (Harris County)
• Gemayel Haynes [https://www.haynesforjudge.com/] for 486th Dist. Court Judge (Harris County)
Houston ISD students, parents, and teachers have had enough
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Mike%20Miles%20HISD%20protest.jpg]
TEA-appointed Houston ISD Superintendent Mike Miles is ONCE AGAIN being publicly called out for his shady dealings, and rightfully so.
READ this blockbuster investigative story to learn more. [https://www.fox26houston.com/news/report-texas-tax-dollars-diverted-out-of-state-to-charter-schools-founded-by-mike-miles]
HISD students, parents, and teachers deserve to have a trusted community leader as superintendent, not a self-dealer who is working to undermine public education in our state.
TOP joins the chorus of state lawmakers, local leaders, and HISD families who want answers, in the wake of this report that claims that millions in Texas taxpayer dollars were diverted out of the state to Colorado charter schools founded by Superintendent Miles.
Upset about this latest Mike Miles development? TAKE ACTION with our allies at the Houston Federation of Teachers here [https://www.nomoreharm.org/take-action] . #ResignMikeMiles
Keeping up the fight against SB4
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/SB4%20Texas%202024.jpeg]
Join us in calling on San Antonio Police Chief Bill McManus to NOT enforce SB4 and prioritize keeping ALL San Antonio communities safe.
SB4 [https://slate.com/news-and-politics/2024/04/sb4-texas-immigration-law-worse-than-you-think.html] is our state's latest racist, unconstitutional law that would let local law enforcement, like SAPD, stop and detain people suspected of being undocumented. It enables racial profiling as it unfairly targets communities of color, and threatens the wellbeing of many Texans who lived in mixed status households.
SB4 will also lead to an increase in incarcerations which will only waste taxpayer dollars to prosecute, and jail people instead of focusing on keeping our community safe.
Other metro area police departments have already come out against this bill, such as Fort Worth and Austin. They maintain that their police shall follow the law but firmly believe that immigration enforcement lies within the hands of federal institutions NOT local law enforcement.
SIGN OUR petition calling on SAPD to NOT enforce SB4 at any cost. [https://secure.everyaction.com/83kSSjU0yUue3NE8yXTP8g2]
For more information, contact Jax Garcia at jaxgarcia@organizetexas.org [jaxgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
TOP Tips: Download the TOP smartphone app to stay plugged in to our work
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20app.png]
Download the TOP smartphone app ( Apple [https://apps.apple.com/us/app/texas-organizing-project/id1563864367] or Android [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.top] ) today , and stay connected to our organizing and voter engagement work, especially as activity at election season picks up. It's free and easy to get started. Stay tuned for informative updates as well as ways you can take action to advance our campaigns!
Español
Las elecciones primarias de segunda vuelta están cerca. Prepárate para VOTAR.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Election%202024.png]
Construir un Texas más progresista, equitativo e inclusivo significa elegir a campeones defensores impulsados por el pueblo que nos ayudarán a ganar en los temas que afectan a nuestras comunidades. Estas elecciones primarias son una oportunidad para que hagamos valer nuestros valores, mostrar nuestro poder progresista y hagamos oír nuestra voz sobre quién queremos que luche por nosotros a nivel local, estatal y federal.
La votación anticipada para la segunda vuelta primaria comienza este lunes 20 de mayo y se extenderá hasta el viernes 24 de mayo. El día de las elecciones es el martes 28 de mayo.
VOTE por los siguientes candidatos respaldados por TOP que estarán en la boleta electoral en Bexar y el condado de Harris:
• Rebeca Clay-Flores [https://rebecaclayflores.com/] para el Comisionado del Condado de Bexar, Pct. 1
• Molly Cook [https://www.mollyfortexas.com/] para el Senado Estatal, Dist. 15 (Condado de Harris)
• Lauren Ashley Simmons [https://www.laurenashleysimmons.com/] para Representante Estatal, Dist. 146 (Condado de Harris)
• Annette Ramirez [https://www.electannetteramirez.com/] para Tasadora-Recaudadora de Impuestos (Condado de Harris)
• Gemayel Haynes [https://www.haynesforjudge.com/] para juez del Tribunal de Distrito 486 (Condado de Harris)
Los estudiantes, padres, y maestros de Houston ISD merecen un cambio ahora
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Mike%20Miles%20HISD%20protest.jpg]
Mike Miles, superintendente de Houston ISD designado por TEA, está siendo criticado públicamente UNA VEZ MÁS por sus negocios turbios, y con razón.
LEA esta exitosa historia de investigación para obtener más información. [https://www.fox26houston.com/news/report-texas-tax-dollars-diverted-out-of-state-to-charter-schools-founded-by-mike-miles]
Los estudiantes, padres y maestros de HISD merecen tener como superintendente a un líder comunitario confiable, no a un aprovechado que trabaja para socavar la educación pública en nuestro estado.
TOP se une al coro de legisladores estatales, líderes locales y familias de HISD que quieren respuestas, a raíz de este informe que afirma que millones de dólares de los contribuyentes de Texas fueron desviados del estado a escuelas charter de Colorado fundadas por el Superintendente Miles.
¿Estás molesto por este último desarrollo de Mike Miles? ACTÚE con nuestros aliados de la Federación de Maestros de Houston aquí. [https://www.nomoreharm.org/take-action] #ResignMikeMiles
Continuando la lucha contra SB4
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/SB4%20Texas%202024.jpeg]
Únase a nosotros para pedirle al jefe de policía de San Antonio, Bill McManus, que NO haga cumplir la SB4 y dé prioridad a mantener seguras a TODAS las comunidades de San Antonio.
La SB4 [https://slate.com/news-and-politics/2024/04/sb4-texas-immigration-law-worse-than-you-think.html] es la última ley racista e inconstitucional de nuestro estado que permitiría a las autoridades locales, como el SAPD, detener y retener a personas sospechosas de ser indocumentadas. Permite la elaboración de perfiles raciales, ya que apunta injustamente a las comunidades de color y amenaza el bienestar de muchos tejanos que vivían en hogares de estatus mixto.
La SB4 también conducirá a un aumento en los encarcelamientos, lo que solo desperdiciará el dinero de los contribuyentes para procesar y encarcelar a personas en lugar de centrarse en mantener segura a nuestra comunidad.
Otros departamentos de policía del área metropolitana ya se han manifestado en contra de estaley, por ejemplo Fort Worth y Austin. Sostienen que su policía debe cumplir la ley, pero creen firmemente que la aplicación de la ley en materia de inmigración está en manos de las instituciones federales, NO de las autoridades locales.
FIRME NUESTRA petición pidiendo al SAPD que NO haga cumplir la SB4 a cualquier costo. [https://secure.everyaction.com/83kSSjU0yUue3NE8yXTP8g2]
Para obtener más información, comuníquese con Jax García en jaxgarcia@organizetexas.org [jaxgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
Consejos de TOP: Descargue la aplicación de teléfono inteligente TOP para mantenerse
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Spanish%20TOP%20app.jpg]
Descargue la aplicación de TOP para teléfonos inteligentes ( Apple [https://apps.apple.com/us/app/texas-organizing-project/id1563864367] o Android [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.top] ) hoy y manténgase conectado con nuestro trabajo de organización y participación de votantes. Es gratis y fácil de empezar. ¡Estén atentos a las actualizaciones informativas, así como a las formas en que puede tomar medidas para avanzar en nuestras campañas!

Prepárate para VOTAR. [] Construir un Texas más progresista, equitativo e inclusivo significa elegir a campeones defensores impulsados por el pueblo que nos ayudarán a ganar en los temas que afectan a nuestras comunidades. Estas elecciones primarias son una oportunidad para que hagamos valer nuestros valores, mostrar nuestro poder progresista y hagamos oír nuestra voz sobre quién queremos que luche por nosotros a nivel local, estatal y federal. La votación anticipada para la segunda vuelta primaria comienza este lunes 20 de mayo y se extenderá hasta el viernes 24 de mayo. El día de las elecciones es el martes 28 de mayo. VOTE por los siguientes candidatos respaldados por TOP que estarán en la boleta electoral en Bexar y el condado de Harris: • Rebeca Clay-Flores [] para el Comisionado del Condado de Bexar, Pct. 1 • Molly Cook [] para el Senado Estatal, Dist. 15 (Condado de Harris) • Lauren Ashley Simmons [] para Representante Estatal, Dist. 146 (Condado de Harris) • Annette Ramirez [] para Tasadora-Recaudadora de Impuestos (Condado de Harris) • Gemayel Haynes [] para juez del Tribunal de Distrito 486 (Condado de Harris) Los estudiantes, padres, y maestros de Houston ISD merecen un cambio ahora [] Mike Miles, superintendente de Houston ISD designado por TEA, está siendo criticado públicamente UNA VEZ MÁS por sus negocios turbios, y con razón. LEA esta exitosa historia de investigación para obtener más información. [] Los estudiantes, padres y maestros de HISD merecen tener como superintendente a un líder comunitario confiable, no a un aprovechado que trabaja para socavar la educación pública en nuestro estado. TOP se une al coro de legisladores estatales, líderes locales y familias de HISD que quieren respuestas, a raíz de este informe que afirma que millones de dólares de los contribuyentes de Texas fueron desviados del estado a escuelas charter de Colorado fundadas por el Superintendente Miles. ¿Estás molesto por este último desarrollo de Mike Miles? ACTÚE con nuestros aliados de la Federación de Maestros de Houston aquí. [] #ResignMikeMiles Continuando la lucha contra SB4 [] Únase a nosotros para pedirle al jefe de policía de San Antonio, Bill McManus, que NO haga cumplir la SB4 y dé prioridad a mantener seguras a TODAS las comunidades de San Antonio. La SB4 [] es la última ley racista e inconstitucional de nuestro estado que permitiría a las autoridades locales, como el SAPD, detener y retener a personas sospechosas de ser indocumentadas. Permite la elaboración de perfiles raciales, ya que apunta injustamente a las comunidades de color y amenaza el bienestar de muchos tejanos que vivían en hogares de estatus mixto. La SB4 también conducirá a un aumento en los encarcelamientos, lo que solo desperdiciará el dinero de los contribuyentes para procesar y encarcelar a personas en lugar de centrarse en mantener segura a nuestra comunidad. Otros departamentos de policía del área metropolitana ya se han manifestado en contra de estaley, por ejemplo Fort Worth y Austin. Sostienen que su policía debe cumplir la ley, pero creen firmemente que la aplicación de la ley en materia de inmigración está en manos de las instituciones federales, NO de las autoridades locales. FIRME NUESTRA petición pidiendo al SAPD que NO haga cumplir la SB4 a cualquier costo. We know that a lot of campaigns are asking you for help right now, and we don’t take your support for granted.
#

Peter, first off: Thank you for putting up with all the emails we sent over the past few days.
Really.
We know that a lot of campaigns are asking you for help right now, and we don’t take your support for granted. Your voice, your participation, even just reading these emails helps more than you might realize.
From this point, it’s an uphill battle to Election Day. We’re in a strong position — but we can’t let up.
Not with so much at stake.
That’s why this next part is so tough. A lot of people stepped up and made a donation ahead of yesterday’s mid-month deadline — the halfway point to our official FEC deadline.
But at the halfway point, we expect to be about 50% of the way to our goal. Today, we’re only tracking to about 35% of the way. That means we’re behind.
These goals aren’t arbitrary. If we raise what we need to, we can win this race. If we don’t, we’re in trouble.
It’s a dangerous move telling you all this, because our opponents might use it against us. But I’m counting on you here, hoping that sharing this information with you might help you understand how important your donations are.

Did you see this? I emailed about it last week, but it's too important to just leave it at that.
Time Magazine interviewed Trump for a story they used for the cover and titled “If he wins.”
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-may24.waY6cu&refcode=em240516-1-LA&t=2&akid=1439%2E135344%2E6B33VI)

First, he said he wouldn't even necessarily accept the outcome of the November election. Again: this is a flashing red warning light not only for those of us who lived through the insurrection at the Capitol in 2021, but for any American who cares about the future of our democracy.
Who can forget this?

You may already know who I am from my time in Congress serving North Carolina's 8th District. Or you may be coming across me for the first time. My name is Dan Bishop, and I'm running for Attorney General for North Carolina with the intention of bringing Law and Order back to the Tar Heel State.

**[This email is a bit longer and I hope you'll read through it. I'm going to ask you for a donation to my campaign at the end of this email, but let me explain why it's so crucial you join my team first.](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=1ea271e8bd0f47e2bacdf4c966769b65&_e=_s3t4Cif86zSmiRQFJZS3YN5tktCPPJaRVrMCEg7Y1XlhNX9PzdoF085zf29zk4hfmQSPJEzG6MCny8AsuQh7g4kYljGNMmCRwhrlXIOxNXTom00GVkVicD8iwy8aq6FS4SHVVnonltbYCcwHnUV22Lis-4ksPLvEkxuEJWqFv4FbB6UhLt27Qqdd_z1qDpLMNMEI5xHvTDBGG4qqUCHaLOdbY6VUsYzJlOVt9vYa4cLW3vwmbuBMsp5w8vraJNCoI1MJdIhsLJD8BUDwc1hCLy38KM_yJQj_H2KCJg-RUDi6huPHEioz-e8OcUEOptp4YYT00fgPjrRr-CYE4wy7CbkztTDoDEATpTFmjNAIjvAz0tmFlWbn3cpxjvS2i550-Xgg3Am35omzTpTOy6_GjksaMBuZATLSEnOfBvwbXw%3D)**

I was born and raised with my four siblings in North Carolina by my parents, Kaytee and Bud. They didn't come from much, but they pushed me towards an education and instilled a hard work ethic. With a passion for law and justice, I earned my JD at UNC Chapel Hill. I then went on to marry my wife of 25 years (and going), Jo; we raised our son, Jack, who's currently following in his dad's footsteps as he's working to attain his law degree.

As a lawyer, I'm very proud of my track record. I was a commercial litigator for nearly three decades, where I was voted 10 times to Business NC's "Legal Elite" and was selected 7 times by "Super Lawyers." I was tenacious as a litigator and handled complex cases. But, I finally felt that it was time to help a broader scope of North Carolinians and decided to run for Congress.

In Congress, I've been one of the toughest and most outspoken conservatives, challenging the radical left and holding my fellow Republicans accountable. As a member of the judiciary committee and the subcommittee on the weaponization of the federal government, I fought the Biden administration's dangerous policies and exposed the federal government's abuses against the Trump presidency.

Now, I'm running for Attorney General to defend the rule of law and protect North Carolina. I believe Democrats like Roy Cooper and Josh Stein have abused the state's top law enforcement office by turning it into a stepping stone for higher office and a platform to spread liberal propaganda. I'm putting my foot down, demanding respect for the office of Attorney General, and bringing Law and Order back to our great state.

**All that to say, I have a track record of fighting the good fight. And I hope you'll join my team. The good fight is not free; running a campaign gets expensive, having to reach voters across the state, taking care of campaign staffers with food and gas, and running ads on TV.** **[That's why I'm humbly asking you for a donation of whatever you can afford.](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=1ea271e8bd0f47e2bacdf4c966769b65&_e=_s3t4Cif86zSmiRQFJZS3YN5tktCPPJaRVrMCEg7Y1XlhNX9PzdoF085zf29zk4hfmQSPJEzG6MCny8AsuQh7g4kYljGNMmCRwhrlXIOxNXTom00GVkVicD8iwy8aq6FS4SHVVnonltbYCcwHnUV22Lis-4ksPLvEkxuEJWqFv4FbB6UhLt27Qqdd_z1qDpLMNMEI5xHvTDBGG4qqUCHaLOdbY6VUsYzJlOVt9vYa4cLW3vwmbuBMsp5w8vraJNCzu6H0Diy4ty5MMGiV_MauABdPaj2ZWWnRo3u9_mBABc_3SiN2eb9s1veD9rI3ZRIu1H2O_NEKakAjgW2oAlRNv9jIVe9v3wSt0BlQdZoBNUlJFAhyqUuuIFPiei3k2WkSl78ubXLU50sZt834nQhx-sq-EnWwV3Zn9AxECDIrhU%3D)**

If you've gotten this far, I want to personally thank you for reading this email. Maybe it means you've been a supporter for quite some time. Thank you,

body:

**Hey friend. **

Listen, I have one simple question for you.

**Are you really on my team?**

My finance team just called and informed me we missed our last fundraising deadline by - well, to put it bluntly - **a LOT.**

**You can 't blame me for wanting to check on you and confirm your support for conservative values, small government, secure borders, and safe streets.**

In this day and age, who knows what crazy scheme the Dems and Biden could dream up? We must ensure we're prepared for their attacks come election year, and the preparation starts NOW.

Friend, missing deadlines doesn't just make me look bad - it makes our movement look bad. Which is just more ammunition for the Left to outspend us, outraise us, and **BEAT** us in elections.

name: Rep. John Ray Clemmons
subject: Meet us in Nashville
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tennessee House Democratic Caucus | Ronnie Glynn, Treasurer
body:
https://tnhousedems.com/ [https://tnhousedems.com/]
Peter,
We kicked off our post-session, statewide bus tour last week! We’re back on the road listening to Tennessee families and meeting with local officials, union leaders and fellow Democrats to prepare for the upcoming elections.
RSVP for Davidson County Fundraiser [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nashvilleab]
Here’s the deal: to make progress towards breaking the GOP supermajority and get our state back to work for the people of Tennessee, we‘ve got to flip some seats. This costs money. Competitive state house campaigns cost between $250,000 to $600,000. If we could fully fund every Democratic running in Tennessee, we would, but resources are limited. This is why we are strategically investing in key races and candidates across our state, and we want to talk with you about how you can make a difference.
We’re pouring every dollar we raise into these targeted seats. We need your insights and investment so please come out and join me and several of my caucus colleagues on Wednesday, June 12th for cocktails and conversation. Click here to add your name to the host committee or to purchase tickets . [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nashvilleab]
After another brutal legislative session, I’m looking forward to seeing my longtime friends and Democratic allies in Nashville soon.
John Ray Clemmons

**Friend, have you heard what happened in Florida? **

Their state Supreme Court recently ruled to allow a six-week abortion ban, and it officially took effect on May 1. It's a pattern we're seeing in states all across the country. And it'll only stop if we protect our Senate majority and finally pass legislation to restore reproductive rights nationwide.
**That’s why my friend, Debbie Mucarsel-Powell, is doing _everything_ in her power to defeat her Republican opponent, Rick Scott, flip Florida blue, and save our Senate majority. But she's counting on your grassroots support to win. **[**Will you split $5 between me and Debbie to help her win Florida and keep the Senate blue?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85059329/473527959/-1736033032?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk5040-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNTM3M2RiZC05NzEzLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxNGRhZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OUr7gIJ21lYjFwFQ3MZCRa9-QtbMfNd2ajCo9WFCST4=)
Unlike her opponent, who cosponsored a national abortion ban and supported the extreme six-week ban in Florida, Debbie is committed to fighting for every woman’s reproductive freedom. She trusts that women, not their politicians, can make their own health care decisions.
Friend, you know I am fighting tirelessly in the Senate to defend freedoms like our reproductive rights. But the far-right radicals have a clear path to retaking the Senate this fall, and they’re coming for both Florida and New York seats.
**Extremist Republicans _need_ to be stopped, and with your help — we can do just that. **

Every dollar we raise helps us drown out the NRA and their message of fear with our message of hope
#

Tomorrow, the NRA is beginning their annual convention. This year, it’s being held in Dallas, Texas.
[**So we need to ask: Can you contribute $3 right away to help fuel our work to defeat the NRA?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-may24.vNbcqy&refcode=em240516-1-30&t=1&akid=8105%2E3935704%2EtAJzMV)

Riddled with scandal, fraud, and misconduct, the NRA is the weakest it’s ever been. Earlier this year, longtime CEO and Executive Director Wayne LaPierre resigned in disgrace. Soon after, a jury found him and the NRA liable for corruption and financial mismanagement. In 2018, the NRA had 5.5 million members. When I wake up in the morning and shut my eyes at night I'm thinking about ways to fight for the American people, to protect fundamental rights, and to defend our democracy. **That is the privilege and responsibility of a President, and I don't take it for granted for even a second. However, Donald Trump has a different vision of a President, one who only thinks about himself and how to enrich his friends.** Time and time again, my predecessor has made it clear: when he wakes up every morning, he’s only worried about himself. But Donald Trump is ratcheting up his attacks, lies, and spending to try to derail our momentum and secure a second term. I won’t let that happen, and I know the folks on this grassroots team won’t let it happen either. So are you with us? My opponent, Tony Gonzales, went on national TV and called me a "Neo-Nazi."
Throughout my campaign, I've focused like a laser on his public statements and his voting record, but because he knows he can't win on his dismal record, he's resorted to name-calling.
I have faith in the voters of this district, that they can see through the lies and focus on what matters: a choice between a "Democrat Lite" who votes for gun control and a border in chaos that puts us all at risk, or a constitutional conservative who understands the meaning of "shall not be infringed" and will end Joe Biden's open border policy.
But I'm told our television ads will stop in the last week because we still have a budget shortfall of around $100k.

One person dies every six hours due to gun violence here in Pennsylvania, friend.
I don’t know about you, but we think _it’s time to take our communities back._
Governor Shapiro recently proposed a _massive_ $100 million investment to reduce gun violence in our state. Legislators from both sides of the aisle are coming together to tackle this issue head-on.
**Frankly, it’s about time!**
But remember: _**This is just a proposal.**_ We still have a lot of work to do if we want to make it a reality. Governor Shapiro is going to need your support to ensure a safer Pennsylvania.
It’s up to us to let our state legislators know that Pennsylvania deserves better than gun violence. We deserve better gun safety, better background checks, and better regulations. _But we have to keep up the fight to make it happen._

Crooked, corrupt politicians might try their hardest to get away with their crimes, but I’m determined to do everything in my power to finally bring shady forces to justice. = | | = = For years, I’ve been going toe-to-toe with the corrupt who have ruled our nation for generations to hold them accountable. Yes, I’ve gained new enemies since standing up against these powerful people and groups, but I’ve also helped and defended hardworking New Yorkers – and I wouldn’t have it any other way. But my fight for the vulnerable and voiceless is far from over. Right now, corrupt corporations and politicians alike are doing everything they can to escape the consequences of their actions, posing huge threats to the rule of law as we know it. But threats like these only fuel my passion to fight for people like YOU. I’m determined to continue my fight against the corrupt men in power, but I can’t do it without your support, Peter.= If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you for standing by me, Letitia | With so many tough and crucial fights ahead, I am counting on people like you to fuel my fight for justice, progress, and true equality. Will you make a monthly donation to make sure I can continue using the full power of the Attorney General's office to make a difference for everyday people and families? | = | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Peter, A few days ago I sent out an email about New York and I want to make sure the message didn't slip through the cracks. **Right now our campaign is fighting an intense battle against the biggest challenge we’ve faced yet.** We need tens of thousands more signatures to get on the ballot in New York - and with just two weeks left, we’re behind where we need to be. **From the bottom of my heart, I’m asking every one of you to[do whatever you can ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/nyballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=resend_ny_appeal_5_16&n=2)**[**_now_**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/nyballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=resend_ny_appeal_5_16&n=3)**[to help us get on the ballot in New York](https://www.jillstein2024.com/nyballot?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=resend_ny_appeal_5_16&n=4) and keep us on track to put an anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate action campaign on _every single ballot_ across the country.**
---

---
**Genocide in Gaza is going off the charts right now with the assault on Rafah,** where 1.4 million people have been herded like cattle and are now targeted like fish in a barrel - including 600,000 wounded, malnourished, sick, traumatized children. With Israel's closure of the Rafah crossing last week choking off the little water and food that were getting in, and bombing the entire Gaza strip, **this is a grand finale to 75 years of ethnic cleansing.** **We must do everything in our power to shut this genocide down. That means turning up the political demand by getting our opposition to genocide on the ballot in New York - ensuring this is a national force that cannot be stopped!** To make that happen, we _urgently_ need volunteers as well as people who would like to get paid to petition. If you can come, let us know and we’ll get in touch to make arrangements for your visit, including accommodations if you need them. If you live within a bus ride of New York, and need help getting there, we can help you get there. We also need folks in NY or nearby who can provide housing or transportation for petitioners. **However you can help, please sign up now:**

Our media coverage has exploded, and endorsements are rolling in, from Professor Jeffrey Sachs to Medea Benjamin, Kyle Kulinski, Jenan Matari, Andy Shallal, Professor Anthony Zenkus, and more. **If we get on the ballot in New York, it will shock the establishment and power our campaign to complete our ballot access nationwide - a process that’s over 75% completed already**. With multiple systemic crises hitting at the same time and rejection of the establishment candidates at a record high, the sky's the limit for what lies ahead in this race - including a real shot at the White House. **This is do or die for our campaign.** **And it's do or die for putting opposition to genocide front and center in this election. Every day matters and every signature counts.** **If you can collect signatures in New York, we need your help now. If you can donate to help us fund our petition drive, please pitch in whatever you can now.** **If you believe in this movement for people, planet, and peace, I ask you to join me in this historic moment and do whatever you can to help us get on the ballot in New York now!**

Peter — In 2023, Arizonans experienced 133 days with temperatures over 100 degrees. And this year may be even worse. The first 100-degree day last year didn’t happen until April 30th — but this year it was on April 22nd, eight days sooner. This is deadly serious. Nearly 650 people died of heat-related causes in Maricopa County last year — a 52% increase over 2022. The county has set a new heat death record in each of at least the past six years. Arizona is at the epicenter of the global climate crisis, and it’s affecting all of our daily lives. # FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Peter, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

We couldn’t be farther apart in terms of policy, and couple that with the fact that a Hogan victory would all-but guarantee a GOP-controlled Senate, and it’s clear that Hogan is all wrong for Maryland. **[I’ll prove it to you, Peter, but before I highlight 3 major policy differences between me and Larry Hogan, can you chip in $25 and be one of the 10,000 grassroots donors we need to hit our General Election Founding Donor Goal?](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/25021?t=11&amount=25&akid=1686%2E52803%2EjIpjl3)** | | | [Donate $25](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/25021?t=12&amount=25&akid=1686%2E52803%2EjIpjl3)

Larry Hogan and I disagree on a lot of things, and here are 3 areas where we differ:
_I believe abortion should be safe, legal, and accessible for everyone, but Hogan disagrees._
**During his time as governor, he vetoed legislation to expand abortion access, and you’d better believe he’d support a national abortion ban. He was even so condescending as to belittle abortion as _“an emotional issue for women.”_**
_I believe that workers’ rights should be expanded, and unions given more power to collectively bargain, but Hogan disagrees._
**He vetoed a law that would have allowed workers to deduct union dues from state income taxes.**
_I believe that we can and should be doing more to improve the lives of working Marylanders, but again, Hogan disagrees._
**That’s why he vetoed a $15 minimum wage.**

name: Ro Khanna
subject: My speech tonight in Dearborn
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

How can we have a conversation in America that condemns the horrific Oct. 7 Hamas attack and kidnappings, reckons with what has transpired since, and respects the stories and struggles, the trauma and tears, of both Arab Americans and Jewish Americans?

That’s the question I asked at the beginning of my speech [https://www.washingtonpost.com/opinions/2024/05/16/freedom-speech-protection-campus-protests/] to the Arab American Civil Rights League in Dearborn, Michigan. I was deeply honored to be in Dearborn to receive a “Profile in Courage” award in recognition of my support for a permanent ceasefire in Gaza and the release of all hostages.

But I’m also deeply troubled both by the humanitarian crisis in the Middle East and by the collapse of civil dialogue in America. We need to find better ways to have difficult conversations in America.

Read excerpts from my speech in the Washington Post: To best protect freedom of speech, let’s speak to one another. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/opinions/2024/05/16/freedom-speech-protection-campus-protests/]

https://www.washingtonpost.com/opinions/2024/05/16/freedom-speech-protection-campus-protests/ [https://www.washingtonpost.com/opinions/2024/05/16/freedom-speech-protection-campus-protests/]

I am proud of young people in America today. Despite the attention-grabbing headlines, many of them are building multi-faith coalitions that respect each other’s traditions.
Historically speaking, student-led movements have been the conscience of our nation, challenging wars abroad and unjust political norms at home, whether it be for civil rights, women's rights, or gay rights. Today, students –– Jews, Arabs, Muslims, Christians, Hindus, and nonbelievers –– are coming together to insist that America speak up for justice for Palestine and for an end to the brutal war.

Our nation must always stand for free speech, whether that speech is critical of Israel, of Hamas, or of America itself. Criticism of the policies of a government in power is neither a rejection of patriotism nor an expression of bigotry.

An open society like ours is designed for sharp disagreement and controversy. But the defense of dissent does not absolve us of the moral responsibility to call out protests when they devolve into toxic and vile threats against Jews or any ethnic group. Prejudice is not a form of discussion.

Our standard for discourse cannot be merely the toleration of the other. Toleration itself requires the unequivocal rejection of antisemitism or Islamophobia. More than toleration, what is needed is respect for differing narratives. Not approval, but respect.

We need fewer shouters today and more thinkers. More peacemakers. Americans must step forward and offer novel solutions to problems that have overwhelmed and confounded the current Washington establishment.

I hope you take 5 minutes to read my speech in The Washington Post [https://www.washingtonpost.com/opinions/2024/05/16/freedom-speech-protection-campus-protests/] . You can text me at (650) 999-9610 to let me know what you think.

Thank you for your activism and all that you do.

Onward,
Ro

Ro doesn't accept a cent from lobbyists or PACs, meaning our work is completely funded by grassroots supporters like you. By donating just $3 today, you’re helping us create a country that works for everyone, not just those at the top. That means a renewed investment in American manufacturing, Medicare for All, student debt relief, and a green future.

November 10th will officially mark one month since I announced my campaign. We’re halfway through the second quarter of the election year—an important benchmark on our way to the next FEC deadline.
Our team sets fundraising benchmarks for each week, each month, each quarter, and each year all to support the overall goal of winning elections. Of course, the stakes for winning are high, but you know this already. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240516?refcode=lpfe240516]

We don’t have to imagine what will happen if Donald Trump returns to the White House. He’s laid out his agenda in his own words: extreme and cruel immigration policies, undermining independent law enforcement, endangering our relationships with our allies, and letting states monitor and prosecute women who violate abortion bans.
The outcome of these elections will affect reproductive rights, voting rights, equal rights, health care access, and so much more. This election is important, and that means staying on track to our goals is important, too. The resources we raise now shape the campaign we can run. And our on-the-ground organization will play a big role in the outcome on Election Day.
We’re making great progress toward our goal, and your contributions help keep us on track ahead of the FEC deadline. name: Lila Rose
subject: Stop CVS from killing preborn children
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Friend of
Life,

Did you
know that America's most popular diaper brands, including
Huggies, Pampers, Hello Bello, and Honest Co., all support
abortion?

This is
peak irony. Brands that provide a necessity for babies also
financially and/or publicly support an act that intentionally
kills innocent children in the womb.

As
pro-life people, we can do something to put a stop to this.

Live
Action is hosting a diaper drive with EveryLife - the first
pro-life diaper company - to help mothers and their babies in
need.

If you're
tired of supporting brands that don't align with your pro-life
values, you can do something now to help women AND support a
pro-life business.

Your gift
of just $50 will provide six packs of EveryLife diapers to a mom
who is considering abortion or is facing a crisis and help her
embrace life. We are searching for 100 people who can give before
midnight so we can get diapers to local pro-life pregnancy
centers nationwide.

Is this
something you can do? Here's your secure link to give:
https://give.liveaction.org/send-a-box-of-diapers-to-a-mom-in-need/

EveryLife
prides itself in being a pro-life company that uses premium
materials for their diapers- and better yet, EveryLife promotes
the message that every baby is a miracle from God who deserves to
be loved, protected, and supported.

Your gift
will send a box of diapers to a local pro-life pregnancy clinic
so that moms days away from a potentially life-ending decision
can receive the practical support they need to choose life.

There's
only a few hours to go and we haven't been able to reach our goal
of 100 partners before midnight. Please consider donating right
now before this opportunity expires.

Thank you
in advance for standing with us against big abortion and
equipping moms to choose life.

For Life,

Lila Rose
President
and Founder

Wilson Blvd, Suite 102, PMB 111 Arlington, VA 22201

name: Sara (personal)
subject: I am the woman I am today because of my Grandma Joan
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
Friends, if you’ve been reading my emails for a while, you know that I like to share what’s on my mind – and you also may have noticed that you haven’t gotten an email from me in a few weeks.
Last Monday, my grandma, Joan Jacobs, passed away. It was a big loss for our family.
I am the woman I am today because I am her granddaughter.
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/69634E537676684957686A457844662F6230385246654D515952786331636B576E503970502F726F396D4E794E4E57526B545444334D66423663717A75396E44/editor_images/GrandmaJoan.png]
After four sons (and then my brother), I was her first girl. Rumor has it that there was nothing pink left in San Diego the day I was born because she bought it all. And she spent every day making sure I knew I was special and loved.
She pushed me and everyone around her to be the best versions of themselves. She taught me that it was possible to be feminine and strong and opinionated. That I could be a wife and mother and grandmother, and also a leader.
She taught me the importance of giving back and never taking for granted the things life gave me. That it was my responsibility to use the privileges I’d been given to make San Diego and the world better and fairer. She taught me the importance of art and theater and music. She was one of the most stylish and fashionable women I’ve ever known. She was a matriarch in every sense of the word, and not just of our family but of all of San Diego.
I will forever cherish the time we spent together and always remember the lessons she taught me. And I’ll teach them to my children too one day.
In grief and gratitude,
Sara Jacobs

Not only have we announced our first slate of 2024 Leaders We Deserve endorsed candidates — we even won an early victory when Christine Cockley won her primary in Ohio!

[_**Peter, the outpouring of support from this grassroots team is providing an enormous boost to each of our candidates. We need to keep up our momentum as we get closer to the November election. * Sarah McBride for U.S. Congress (Delaware)
* Christine Cockley for Ohio House
* Bryce Berry for Georgia House
* Ashwin Ramaswami for Georgia Senate
* Anna Thomas for Pennsylvania House
* Anja Wookey-Huffman for Montana House

From now until November, we’ll be doing everything we can to elect these young progressive leaders to fight for our generation’s values and defend our future.

And, just like we did in Virginia last year, we’re preparing to make significant investments in each of these campaigns to help them win big this November.

We’re going to be on the ground supporting all of our 2024 endorsed candidates by running ads, managing effective volunteer and canvassing programs, and helping them reach the voters they will need on their side to win these races.

**I’ll be blunt: Winning these races isn’t cheap. These campaigns require serious resources — and that’s why the support from this grassroots team is so vital.**

| Friend, over the past few months, I've spoken with hundreds of voters here in TX-31 -- small business owners, recognized leaders in our community, veterans, teachers, and everyday working people -- about what their priorities are for Congress.
But today, I want to share my own priorities with you. As our runoff election gets closer and closer (just 11 days to go till Election Day!), it's important that you know exactly what matters to me -- values that motivate me in our campaign against my extremist Republican opponent, John Carter, and that reflect a lot of what you've all shared with me about your families and neighborhoods.
I've laid out my core priorities below, just in case you missed seeing me in person, or if you're new to our movement (and if so, welcome!!).

| I will do everything in my power to protect our democracy and defend our civil liberties, and am ready to stand up to threats against Texans' fundamental freedoms whenever necessary.
I am dedicated to championing abortion rights and health care access, and will defend against any right-wing attempt to limit reproductive healthcare, fertility treatments, or birth control. Women have the right to choose -- period.
I will work to create an economy that expands all of our opportunities -- whether that's on main street or Wall Street (y'all know Main Street in Cedar Park, right?), in our factories and our Texas farms.
I will live up to our nation's commitment to our active-duty military and veterans and work to protect those who've served as they've protected all of us. Their healthcare should be a matter of national security -- it is unconscionable that my opponent tried to block the VA from providing reproductive healthcare services, and more.
I will stand up for our nation's seniors, and will work to protect social security and Medicare benefits from extremist Republican budget cuts.
Finally, I promise to fight for a more functional Congress, where we work for the people of this country, not special interests.

Dear Friend,

Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **[National Survey on the Department of Justice](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=5fc28b39be5e4cb09fa19e0818cbdd7a&_e=innCWjlWQtjt_mLWIwYpCPqwY19cXPxxa2AT-43oebEFxFrmm5HipdWBLGvFLEnRBiaY85xa-8QpDo8VHWio1OFE17eLj_fGzAFR37P0qtu2ZEN0CtmeXDJWA5AUKZHHIFR0kHquzXbtAxV43rmf19sqNodJSVPUJXVO8gqWPFJ1lZAsSQUO6HG8Xz0i5uviCAx87CjwP_-J35utLSyHjaCkW08vk78VNenJqOEznP28t5mSP_q4NSGZhgnwqyg-AdUO6p4WD5zA7DhYFXoxd7ZqpRIf31vO98P3IRF_hmQi-KNMvrt_FjgaE734AYUkfKirV_9pzhnNKCzGcxI9rTqlnG_vkeFr8fGqRDHIKNXYM70mh1eZdO3OmPOO27K-dUGBS770w7VUwvUbq0MMcg%3D%3D).**

The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the [Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=5fc28b39be5e4cb09fa19e0818cbdd7a&_e=innCWjlWQtjt_mLWIwYpCPqwY19cXPxxa2AT-43oebEFxFrmm5HipdWBLGvFLEnRBiaY85xa-8QpDo8VHWio1OFE17eLj_fGzAFR37P0qtu2ZEN0CtmeXDJWA5AUKZHHIFR0kHquzXbtAxV43rmf19sqNodJSVPUJXVO8gqWPFJ1lZAsSQUO6HG8Xz0i5uviCAx87CjwP_-J35utLSyHjaCkW08vk78VNenJqOEznP2_lWmiB6HAwFNChe7lzHZqCC1REhXJnCblECmvr6R8AxqtM6NK5LtQQH9yI0DaetfSbRgKUnm8iMPKJkMzzOGv6ZEaXl5IcllGnWNmWs2ooV8AP7i0NWpZpKhwqsJ25oZ7iBj_ZlgdFU8TtvsDEuqrVgh4ayrII0xNWk_BMp4m6Q%3D%3D).**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=5fc28b39be5e4cb09fa19e0818cbdd7a&_e=innCWjlWQtjt_mLWIwYpCPqwY19cXPxxa2AT-43oebEFxFrmm5HipdWBLGvFLEnRBiaY85xa-8QpDo8VHWio1OFE17eLj_fGzAFR37P0qtu2ZEN0CtmeXDJWA5AUKZHHIFR0kHquzXbtAxV43rmf19sqNodJSVPUJXVO8gqWPFJ1lZAsSQUO6HG8Xz0i5uviCAx87CjwP_-J35utLSyHjaCkW08vk78VNenJqOEznP3VBT4qMRkQnlbOP3UnD4rB29edbqIOw-rfqDW4e2HerBNZFFn0E9BaJd1gwJM22Yu6x99FUIAPQeSv-NxZO-ZoT3ThS2sGGknRUkS0MFrjuskMWxkyIEpT6v6okssLKICZvfedMlB4jGO4u4Pfp4TFij8YVNivq-JL40iDenxQ_g%3D%3D)**

The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.**

Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack.

**You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.**

A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.**

These efforts include:

**Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

So please share your views by completing our [**National Survey on the Department of Justice**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=5fc28b39be5e4cb09fa19e0818cbdd7a&_e=innCWjlWQtjt_mLWIwYpCPqwY19cXPxxa2AT-43oebEFxFrmm5HipdWBLGvFLEnRBiaY85xa-8QpDo8VHWio1OFE17eLj_fGzAFR37P0qtu2ZEN0CtmeXDJWA5AUKZHHIFR0kHquzXbtAxV43rmf19sqNodJSVPUJXVO8gqWPFJ1lZAsSQUO6HG8Xz0i5uviCAx87CjwP_-J35utLSyHjaCkW08vk78VNenJqOEznP1juPAXcOqqydohpGm_V1frgTAI2spMa8Q7cwWQAnOsHHJQOlM320Yd4qaB_VXWZ3RdW_qQ5JmcLvZ1rxLU4XkTW3L3t-vtiOXqHiH-TsBuhVyiTaqHmyfX_UBIejVb-X6ema1nU3-QA0BSvrCv7LSkTO9EXMaBoLHORWV3oDraJg%3D%3D) and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

**This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=5fc28b39be5e4cb09fa19e0818cbdd7a&_e=innCWjlWQtjt_mLWIwYpCPqwY19cXPxxa2AT-43oebEFxFrmm5HipdWBLGvFLEnRBiaY85xa-8QpDo8VHWio1OFE17eLj_fGzAFR37P0qtu2ZEN0CtmeXDJWA5AUKZHHIFR0kHquzXbtAxV43rmf19sqNodJSVPUJXVO8gqWPFJ1lZAsSQUO6HG8Xz0i5uviCAx87CjwP_-J35utLSyHjaCkW08vk78VNenJqOEznP2aTkFlDc-DTI_Y7VDbrRqOwoTMEfZBCCWCOJnHNgdgle0KZkjI-p20K7XOawFVKPDDopctW29BROyh4cU_JWUH_MPLysjgs5ZD8O8oDtYGCg-1BwldmvEwzKIyk6eKr3R5LLNjc3x0qf6_hRhgllTVcI7PV8_gSd9CScBHRQIvrQ%3D%3D)**

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

It’s a special monologue-only episode with my thoughts exploring a question that no one has been able to answer: what exactly is the crime that President Donald Trump is being prosecuted for? Last week, I sparred with Ann Coulter. We talked about the N word: Nationalism. | | |

Peter —
This is huge. We just launched RFK Activate, our new mobile app!
Now you can carry the campaign in your pocket and take your own virtual Kennedy Headquarters with you on the go.
As one of our most steadfast volunteers, we want you to have the first opportunity to test the Beta version of the app, before anyone else.
Additionally, our first 1000 users to create an account will receive a 24% off coupon to our merch store!
The RFK Activate app is available for both [Apple](https://www.kennedy24.com/r?u=KXGvx7aasFY27PiPz167twOpkKrjKWLnUxtF_YQtNqg4fiOoseJCbgDG8hsqPfGMsAW-GDPaN05_B-547lcJtF-QXcIdnPdaQQ36biRldJsdquBb6MNH-Sntvvl957zw&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=rfk_activate_app_5_16_24_a1&n=2) and [Android](https://www.kennedy24.com/r?u=KXGvx7aasFY27PiPz167twOpkKrjKWLnUxtF_YQtNqg4fiOoseJCbgDG8hsqPfGMsAW-GDPaN05_B-547lcJtF-QXcIdnPdaQQ36biRldJsdquBb6MNH-Sntvvl957zw&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=rfk_activate_app_5_16_24_a1&n=3), and offers a range of features designed to inform, connect and empower our millions of supporters and volunteers alike. Here’s what you can expect:
**1\. Stay Informed: All your Kennedy campaign news in a single feed!** Browse the app’s HQ tab of the app to watch Bobby’s latest videos, read new policies, and be the first to see campaign media alerts on the issues of the day!
**2\. Connect and Organize: All the most meaningful ways you can help win the White House right from where you are – even if that’s curled up on your couch!** Check the app’s Actions tab to discover or host grassroots events, sign up new supporters, take part in an emailing campaign, or hit the sidewalk tabling or door-knocking in your neighborhood. s No matter what your unique superpowers may be, RFK Activate has plenty of different ways to put your genius to work.
**3\. Access to Campaign Materials: A searchable media library for spreading the word on the go!** Explore the Materials tab to find a wealth of RFK videos, graphics, memes, flyers, logos, stickers and gifs to share on social media or via SMS. Remember to check out our designs for updating your social headers and profile pictures. We’ve got plenty of options to suit your style and share your support with the world.
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/r?u=KXGvx7aasFY27PiPz167twOpkKrjKWLnUxtF_YQtNqg4fiOoseJCbgDG8hsqPfGMsAW-GDPaN05_B-547lcJtF-QXcIdnPdaQQ36biRldJsdquBb6MNH-Sntvvl957zw&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=rfk_activate_app_5_16_24_a1&n=4)
RFK Activate is more than just an app— it’s a catalyst for grassroots hyper-growth as we join forces to take our country back for the people.. **Together, we are too many voices to silence.**
So please, [download the RFK Activate app](https://www.kennedy24.com/r?u=KXGvx7aasFY27PiPz167twOpkKrjKWLnUxtF_YQtNqg4fiOoseJCbgDG8hsqPfGMsAW-GDPaN05_B-547lcJtF-QXcIdnPdaQQ36biRldJsdquBb6MNH-Sntvvl957zw&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=rfk_activate_app_5_16_24_a1&n=5) from the App Store or Google Play Store, and be sure five of your friends do the same.
Whether you can volunteer 40 hours a week or simply want to browse campaign updates with a late-night cup of tea, RFK Activate is for you. And be sure to download it fast –**the first 1,000 users will receive a 24% discount on their next purchase of official Kennedy Merch!**
Can’t wait to see you out there on the trail!
Team Kennedy

What are grounds for a **biblical divorce**? This question has been hotly debated for 2000 years in the Church. **Jesus** says grounds for a biblical divorce = "_except for sexual immorality_." What does that mean? Is _abuse_ grounds for a biblical divorce? I address this and more in the series we are going through at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10604589.5118.1.7245bba8e4eea1261627e743f2eb060e) over the[Gospel of Matthew](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10604589.5119.1.344e05a96930b4b1e2fd74a4e56d01b0). I also address how to _prevent_ a marriage from ever reaching the place of grounds for a biblical divorce. Watch [Matthew Pt. 9 - SEX, MARRIAGE + DIVORCE](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10604589.5120.1.e21a6087dd8d0aeb2fd7a187cd102d97) here: [https://youtube.com/live/QBndJugRbTo](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=10604589.5121.1.4d489e609beb94df58eb9e2e27728ce6) Thank you,

name: Wes Moore
subject: Did you see the email from Sen. Cardin?
body:
Friend,

I am so excited to see the Marylanders uniting behind Angela Alsobrooks to be our next US Senator — and the leader of that movement is our friend Ben! I wanted to make sure you saw the email he sent yesterday. And more importantly, I hope I can count on you to join us in supporting Angela and Democrats up and down the ticket!

If Republican Larry Hogan wins this November, he would tip the balance of power in the US Senate to Republicans and they would get to control the agenda. That means a nationwide abortion ban, extreme right-wing judges, and repeal of environmental protection laws.

Please check out the note from Senator Cardin below and chip in what you can to support Angela and the coordinated campaign.

Elevate,
Wes Moore

To:
From: Senator Ben Cardin
Date: May 15, 2024
Subject: Join me in supporting Angela Alsobrooks!

Dear Friend,

I was born and raised in Baltimore. I know what it means to be a Marylander – we run on grit, determination and Old Bay. So when I made the personal decision not to run for re-election, I was confident that Marylanders would choose the best person to represent our great state next in the United States Senate.

Who takes this seat matters. Our democracy matters. The health of the Chesapeake Bay matters. Quality education matters. Restoring and codifying reproductive rights matters.

Your vote matters. Who wins in November in Maryland will determine if Democrats keep the majority in the United States Senate, or more civil rights will be put in jeopardy because of extremist judges and lawmakers.
Because this race matters so much, I promise you that I will work just as hard to get Angela Alsobrooks elected as I did to win those 36 elections that allowed me to serve in the House of Delegates, U.S. House of Representatives, and the U.S. Senate.

Angela will fight to make sure our children have clean water to drink and clean air to breathe. She will continue fighting for small businesses to expand and grow all across Maryland. She will stand up for the Chesapeake Bay and for the expansion of mental and behavioral health. Angela will be a champion for women’s rights, reproductive rights, and public safety. She will work every day to make sure our shared Maryland values are at the forefront of this campaign and will guide her work in the U.S. Senate.

Please join me today in supporting Angela Alsobrooks by making a contribution to our coordinated effort to elect her this November.

There is too much at stake this year to sit on the sidelines. We are one seat away from a Republican majority in the United States Senate and a national ban on abortion rights. The balance of power comes down to the voters of Maryland.
Reproductive freedom is on the ballot twice this November. It’s not just about enshrining women’s rights to abortion care in the Maryland Constitution, it’s about a Republican Senate candidate who has a life-long history of denying women access to abortion. The choice could not be clearer.

It’s been the honor of my life to represent the people of Maryland over these many years. Each of you has been an important part of this journey and I want to express my utmost thanks for your support over the years.
For me, there is no greater calling than public service anchored in integrity and civility. I have always tried to listen to people, understand their problems and then work with them to find a solution. I know Angela shares this same commitment and will work tirelessly every day for all Marylanders.

This election could not be more important , for you, for me, and for our children and grandchildren. We have our nominee. Now, we must come together to elect her to the United States Senate.

Please contribute to our effort today. We can’t do this without you.

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90457/images/unnamed%20%283%29.jpg]

Ben Cardin

PS: You can’t sit this out. The consequences are too high. Join me in this effort to elect Angela Alsobrooks by contributing today!

---

name: Bryan
subject: American Elections are for American Citizens.
body:
Did you know that current law in Washington D.C. allows non-citizens to vote in local elections? | | | | |
---
**Did you know that current law in Washington D.C. allows non-citizens to vote in local elections?**
And what’s worse?
**The Washington D.C. Board of Elections is actively encouraging non-citizens to vote in local elections.**
As Chairman of the Committee on House Administration, I held a hearing to raise awareness of this practice and encourage my colleagues to support my legislation that bans non-citizens from voting in American elections.
[Click Here to Read More!](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=d78e4f1dc3&e=e907534017)
American elections are for American citizens.
I’m doing the following to ensure our elections are secure ahead of the upcoming presidential election in November:
* Holding hearings to bring attention to bad election administration practices like [**non-citizen voting**](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=69fff4a103&e=e907534017) and [**private funding of elections**](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=b06c8183ee&e=e907534017).
* Introducing legislation, like my [**American Confidence in Elections Act**](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=69eb60b090&e=e907534017), which implements common sense election integrity policies and increases voter confidence in elections.
* [**Helping Get-Out-The-Vote**](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=84d49561a9&e=e907534017) for important election integrity referendums in Wisconsin.

I’m working hard to ensure we have common sense election integrity policies.
But dark money left-wing groups disagree with my work. That’s one of the reasons they’ve spent **$2.3 million attacking me on Milwaukee TV.**

Friend, my motto has always been that when you love this country, you fight for the people who make it work. That's what I'm doing every day in the Senate.
I'm fighting for the Dignity of Work . No matter where you're from or what kind of work you do, hard work should pay off for everyone. Whether you punch a clock or swipe a badge, earn a salary or make tips, are raising children or caring for an aging parent, I'll fight for you.
I'm fighting for accountability. For years, we've seen corporations lobby for tax breaks and bad trade deals that hurt workers. I'm not afraid to stand up to Wall Street or take on Big Pharma to level the playing field.
I'm fighting for our fundamental rights. My opponent has made it clear he doesn’t have our best interests at heart. I will always fight for a more equal and inclusive country.

Fellow Conservative,

**$98 PER PERSON**
**As a former Navy SEAL** , I’m not intimidated by much. I’ve been around the world and fought on battlefields against enemy soldiers in hand-to-hand combat. As an aerial firefighter, **I’ve piloted planes through some of the most intense wildfires imaginable**.

While I’ve had some thrilling experiences, I’ve never feared the challenges that have been put before me - I assess each situation and determine how best to achieve the desired outcome with minimal harm to myself or to my team.

Last June 27th I declared my candidacy to be the next U.S. Senator for Montana - it was the first time in longer than I can remember that my new day job didn’t involve the risk of serious injury**or even death**. But just because I’m not putting myself in harm’s way at present,**I’m still in the line of fire.**

When I was deciding whether to challenge Jon Tester last spring, I did some digging to find out how much a U.S. Senate campaign costs and what I’d have to raise to be competitive against the last statewide elected Democrat. _**What I discovered shocked me. **_

**_OVER $70 MILLION WAS SPENT IN 2018 - AT THE TIME THE COSTLIEST FEDERAL RACE IN MONTANA’S HISTORY. CAMPAIGNS AND OUTSIDE SUPER PACS SPENT MORE THAN $98 PER PERSON TO INFLUENCE THEIR VOTE._ **

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=14e11fb59c5542769422959b8414d8fa&_e=8hOz-hEOOoktdw2dL0fMZF89S3c326iV6GQ2yetVWompbSwlxzkgxoo-ModxpomSxCNXPAgE3r1RJfXGrnD6L5e-y2Cezbp3c3ney0r9JuiINpd_FaZB6MH9sp1_n6yY5t0b2nJ9ZPPC0JAzPH2Cb0bYP4wGJE3zw65Ud4w3XXA5Z8oG7Y5Nlgk2SK15lXuk5Q0VGmckxX4DUBPji_E95N_HcUtN0A1h1Q455vCy9IaozZsX54UHsh8EagC8IkoYXF3Oz8WDZZOGb47XpqdONFA_mY5s4xja6TVnCeJUEwihRgIBiGaxdzqDDOuyFYFsKiprTgTGN2G4kKakCvVMa9bbYNCntCNQAC7jp9MGJ-tn-HaJJ9hu9SeXR08zT8Nq)
Given that my opponent raised more than $20 million last year **the 2018 record won’t stand.**

While I’m not scared of the task ahead of me, **it is daunting to imagine raising the money I’ll need to successfully win this election.** By some estimates that sum will be more than $100 million dollars.

I know we’re not going to raise the money we need all at once - or even in a year’s time. What I do know is that we will raise it. We’re setting goals each day - and **[if we continue to hit them, we’ll eventually get to where we need to be](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=14e11fb59c5542769422959b8414d8fa&_e=8hOz-hEOOoktdw2dL0fMZF89S3c326iV6GQ2yetVWompbSwlxzkgxoo-ModxpomSxCNXPAgE3r1RJfXGrnD6L5e-y2Cezbp3c3ney0r9JuiINpd_FaZB6MH9sp1_n6yY5t0b2nJ9ZPPC0JAzPH2Cb0bYP4wGJE3zw65Ud4w3XXA5Z8oG7Y5Nlgk2SK15lXuk5Q0VGmckxX4DUBPji_E95N_HcUtN0A1h1Q455vCy9IZuk3_hHQM9BshHNkEkSxJKDXNc4UdTSJ0-wZxMY3VXAC3x18bqhiYFuIPk7jqOd_qikni7Ar5P1LrgMloeyixEAGU08Am_RV-G5dHIEqZK3nN5cYeYKNPshzcVRnCGA3GWWmqFK2DMgibV3uxf0tdq)**.

**[I’m coming to you today to let you know that we’re aiming to raise $999 today](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=14e11fb59c5542769422959b8414d8fa&_e=8hOz-hEOOoktdw2dL0fMZF89S3c326iV6GQ2yetVWompbSwlxzkgxoo-ModxpomSxCNXPAgE3r1RJfXGrnD6L5e-y2Cezbp3c3ney0r9JuiINpd_FaZB6MH9sp1_n6yY5t0b2nJ9ZPPC0JAzPH2Cb0bYP4wGJE3zw65Ud4w3XXA5Z8oG7Y5Nlgk2SK15lXuk5Q0VGmckxX4DUBPji_E95N_HcUtN0A1h1Q455vCy9IawMMeVwCZFbHNDK6M2f0Jbk3ez61UgQMn0gqCGNms97uuQS8r87fq0YpdfA9jOyNrgMGkh04sJYIZ9WCn7EniemjN5vKAUuxpsrf9AfV-26PjrexPJUowGg81yeL6XaCo93STglg8TL7JVuwpv94rS)**.

Divide that by 99 and we just need you and 98 other patriots to **chip in $10** before midnight.

[**HELP ME HIT MY $999 GOAL TODAY ->
**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=14e11fb59c5542769422959b8414d8fa&_e=8hOz-hEOOoktdw2dL0fMZF89S3c326iV6GQ2yetVWompbSwlxzkgxoo-ModxpomSxCNXPAgE3r1RJfXGrnD6L5e-y2Cezbp3c3ney0r9JuiINpd_FaZB6MH9sp1_n6yY5t0b2nJ9ZPPC0JAzPH2Cb0bYP4wGJE3zw65Ud4w3XXA5Z8oG7Y5Nlgk2SK15lXuk5Q0VGmckxX4DUBPji_E95N_HcUtN0A1h1Q455vCy9IZ7YLbAGwxsuZGgGamN-lp-K6H7Z_YfqTTSa0R1DviQTXAiYLdHMD2ukm8rUxRjlEYtWBRtEuGu4I9Qk58yuIPlxy_htec1G6kzYHtFQkxkAUNJxME8MIBB4rakAOB19fcNaW_ucWJx1SwNMeBD_PHa)

Tim Sheehy
