AN OFFICIAL CAMPAIGN UPDATE FROM THE DESK OF KARI LAKE
Fellow American,

As one of my top supporters, I wanted to give you an update about recent developments in our Arizona Senate campaign.

**First:** Independent Senator Kyrsten Sinema dropped out, leaving the race a one-on-one contest between myself and radical leftist Ruben Gallego.

**Then:** Left-wing donors and activist groups donated **over $1 million** to Gallego's campaign in just 24 hours.

**Now:** I'm launching a fundraising blitz to fight back and make sure we have the resources we need to win this race, flip the Senate, and save America.

| [**CHIP IN NOW TO HELP ME FIGHT BACK** ](http://links.gopstateallies.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=4a2320c3e9e54e6eafa0f20ada512824&_e=m9odsoAGr-kD5PWVGy6n-y8Jq0nP_Mc2r2Jn4m3xEHdpmpVx4Ds6ftZNMA7btif2Sh9VJ4qdOIbsCFDdci9Xdoc9UZ1NqffQFZCAMcTody4l9fi6ILf6o4gEIfQ9wPfv3ICdbsuo5n_BHuoVALb8-X6CRJ7DG3F7xIO15uPC-eDE9D2QEcKPPSDDTXIDqCr6CzytZZTHBZMkRCHVEYJw_R14A9ttA9aqQzwflC0AdoYFysvdd3r9-vl-zT94r579J80aVJBg-dKI4sWqkatQE_LuPZwd_zF7kTRMsFG0stsWyojgCe5LRJv8rvkZ0RN_5X5dsX-iR8RrWVbR8ZBlMt6g87cvet53oFEhRXlajZLYQNLb9c6lVzS26rZwaTvIH1a_Au5EQcUrQzuH4axy4gZeGy-RMR-cqUKoJBzvNHY%3D)
---

The road to the Senate majority goes through Arizona. There's simply no way for Republicans to flip the Senate unless we win here. That means if we fall short, we can say goodbye to a secure border, a strong economy, and safe streets.

The good news is polling shows we have the lead. The bad news is with my opponent's massive windfall of cash, and the fake news doing his bidding, our momentum could stall if we don't act fast.

I don't have millionaire liberals from New York and California bankrolling my campaign. I'm relying on grassroots conservative patriots who are sick and tired of what Joe Biden and his cronies have done to our great country. If everyone reading this email chipped in just $20, we'd easily match Gallego's fundraising haul. **I know the stakes. I know that failure is not an option.** That's why I'm putting everything on the line to win. I just need you to join me. **[Can I count on you?](http://links.gopstateallies.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=4a2320c3e9e54e6eafa0f20ada512824&_e=m9odsoAGr-kD5PWVGy6n-y8Jq0nP_Mc2r2Jn4m3xEHdpmpVx4Ds6ftZNMA7btif2Sh9VJ4qdOIbsCFDdci9Xdoc9UZ1NqffQFZCAMcTody4l9fi6ILf6o4gEIfQ9wPfv3ICdbsuo5n_BHuoVALb8-X6CRJ7DG3F7xIO15uPC-eDE9D2QEcKPPSDDTXIDqCr6CzytZZTHBZMkRCHVEYJw_WziDQFrR8Q-dWbZjyOYnRTp-n5qLjjPHpLCbyZAN1rIfrvMkpp9-dxjadHFhwam1kuXNSXZFglp0h9sLTdQZNMRRoQ6_VQJdzOhcnRDWieN_5_RZMdPCN8br1etS8Moh6ODiwO7g1p7lnCIuUvwN4tbCWsbf4m7tp9tn_ZkqXw1f_S8y6xcMHGHZnG_YLFyOg%3D%3D)**

ACROSS THE COMMONWEALTH
VOTE TODAY! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/Make%20A%20Plan%20To%20Vote.png]
You can vote for November's elections NOW! Vote at your Registrar's office during business hours. Saturday early voting is available October 28th and November 4th. Learn More [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
Find your local Registrar's office here: https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/VWCC.jpeg] 15 years of the Community College Access Program at VWCC
Learn More [https://www.wdbj7.com/2023/09/26/virginia-western-celebrates-15th-anniversary-ccap-program/] CCAP is a successful public/private partnership that pays the cost of tuition for three years at Virginia Western Community College if a qualified student does not have sufficient financial aid to pay tuition costs.
This program has helped over 4,200 students achieve higher education!
CANDIDATE SPOTLIGHT
https://karenforvirginia.com/ [https://karenforvirginia.com/] Karen Jenkins for HB-89
Donate Here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/karenforvirginia] Karen Jenkins is a life-long resident of the City of Suffolk. Throughout her lifetime she has passionately advocated for others and currently serves on the Suffolk School Board with a proven track record and history of accomplishments. She is running for the House of Delegates for the 89th District to continue delivering results for the people of Virginia.
She is a champion for education, public safety and mental health. As your next Delegate for the 89th District, she will continue to fight and vote for meaningful policies and legislation to support the needs of the district. At the state level, she will be positioned to write and sponsor bills and laws to benefit the schools and communities in the 89th District and throughout the commonwealth.
LOCAL CANDIDATE EVENTS
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/lily%20canvass.png]
Canvass for Lily Franklin!
On Sundays, join Team Lily at the South County Library Parking Lot from 12 - 12:30 pm for a Roanoke canvassing event!
Bring your walking shoes, a charged cell phone, and water. When you arrive to their launch location you will receive a brief training and literature before being sent out to turf. Questions? Email Beth at egunter3@gmail.com [egunter3@gmail.com] or call 540-353-3645.
South County Library Parking Lot, 6303 Merriman Rd, Roanoke, VA 24018

Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game - Oct. 1 Henrietta Lacks Statue Unveiling - Oct. 4
Join us for the 6th Annual Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game, being held at the Home of the Salem Red Sox - Carilion Clinic Field. A dignified sculpture will commemorate the ongoing and long unrecognized contributions of Roanoke native Henrietta Lacks, who unknowingly provided the world with the HeLa cell, fueling decades of life-saving and life changing research.
Physicians, nurses and administrators will suit up for each hospital during the nine-inning contest. Proceeds will benefit the American Heart Association. Unveiling is October 4th at 11 am at Henrietta Lacks Plaza.
Admission is $5 at the gate, kids under 10 free. Gates open at 1pm and the game starts at 2pm. 410 3rd St SW, Roanoke, VA 24011

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/RCDC.jpeg] Join the Roanoke City Democrats!
Roanoke City Democratic Committee meetings are now in-person and open to non-members. We meet the 3rd Thursday of each month. This month we are meeting at 6 pm at the Main Library (706 S Jefferson St, Roanoke, VA 24016). Sign up for meeting reminders and other information here [https://www.roanokedemocrats.com/subscribe] .
Join us for a social hour every first Thursday of the month at Leonore Restaurant, 128 Campbell St. SW, 5-7 pm.
Join Roanoke Young Dems! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/RYD.png]
Meetings occur on the first Monday and third Sunday of every month in person and virtually. The goal of RYD is to help improve our community and to promote the names of Democratic candidates and policies.
Contact: YoungDemocratsRoanoke@gmail.com [YoungDemocratsRoanoke@gmail.com] to get involved!

Thank you for your support! If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out to me anytime.
My very best,

Friend — Republicans here in Florida have one leading philosophy, and that's to _take_ our rights and freedoms away.

# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38865%2E3422442%2E7yhC6p)
Derek, I have some exciting news to share with you today!
Truth to Power has officially endorsed two more candidates who will bring fresh ideas and much-needed perspectives to Congress: Sarah McBride (DE-AL) and Emily Randall (WA-06).
**[Will you join me in supporting these two trailblazers by splitting a contribution between their campaigns and Truth to Power today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em20240516-endorsements?refcode=em20240516-38865&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38865_3422442_7yhC6p&akid=38865%2E3422442%2E7yhC6p)**
**[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em20240516-endorsements?refcode=em20240516-38865&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38865_3422442_7yhC6p&akid=38865%2E3422442%2E7yhC6p)**
If elected in November, each of these leaders will make history. Sarah McBride would be the first out transgender person in Congress, and Emily Randall would be the first out LGBTQI+ Latina—bringing new and diverse voices to the halls of Congress.
Growing up in a union household and caring for a sister with complex medical needs, Emily Randall will be a powerful advocate for families like hers. She will champion disability justice and fight for all Americans to get the health care they need. In the House, I have spearheaded efforts to increase accessibility in our national parks and to end ableist discrimination in jury service and organ transplants. I’m excited that we can elect a leader like Emily, who has a deep understanding of how government can help disabled Americans participate fully in civic life.
Sarah McBride has a track record of delivering paid family and medical leave in the state legislature, and she’ll bring this same commitment to families to the House. Advocating for pro-family policies that strengthen our workforce and economy, such as paid leave and universal child care, have been top priorities of mine in Congress. As I leave Congress, I’m glad we can have an experienced advocate like Sarah continue in these fights.
I have seen firsthand how important issues for families, like disability justice and paid leave, don’t rise to the top of Congress’ agenda because too many politicians are busy catering to their corporate donors. **Sarah and Emily both refuse to take corporate PAC contributions and will be fighters for the American people, not corporate special interests.**
We need to take back the House this year and elect leaders in our movement, who will continue to take on the tough fights in the House.
**[Please, join me today in supporting Sarah McBride and Emily Randall and help elect both of these leaders today with a contribution.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em20240516-endorsements?refcode=em20240516-38865&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38865_3422442_7yhC6p&akid=38865%2E3422442%2E7yhC6p)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em20240516-endorsements?refcode=em20240516-38865&refcode2=38865_3422442_7yhC6p&akid=38865%2E3422442%2E7yhC6p)
Thank you so much,
Katie Porter

**Katie Porter started Truth to Power to support Democrats who reject corporate PAC money** and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20240516-38865&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=38865_3422442_7yhC6p&akid=38865%2E3422442%2E7yhC6p)**

body:

| Fellow American,

My name is Jo Bishop, and I wanted to pass this email along to you that Dan, my husband, may have already sent you. You don't know me, but you may know him, Dan Bishop.

The establishment parties are trying to prop up their historically unpopular candidates by preventing voters like you from knowing there's a real choice. Meanwhile, Robert F. Kennedy Jr. is insisting they should include _him_ , but not other ballot-qualified candidates like Jill - and he's already ducking requests to debate Jill. **We deserve a real debate for once.**[**Add your name to the petition to demand they include Jill Stein in the presidential debates!**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/debate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=0516_debate_petition&n=2)

name: Tim Sheehy, Navy SEAL
subject: In Montana, it costs $98
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA
body:
Do you know how much political campaigns will spend to win a vote? | [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=a578f37f55fe4364b67c4e28b2a94175&_e=kBODWVV7sMzWjHscjuNxYzLyVPEFSieurSnDelCZtRyG-23dQYWQm29F_gli14WrFCXxXjhwgP9BCoptMoDcMwhaVcPrmNKjYfvLkXyOOF09qgz_2WWSKR3-jQySUnNkniCg_xOMN5VLowaeCkHRyfPWb3n9loqWXaZ8vn7xdOAZciw4j8WZ5F8MSR9msZTPNUfpXHFGa3WRPepCmaR6RqOL-0RXSY8XImhGfik8YKL24rIhMSsb_6BVFVyRYTIcxbxo2sK_Ux2UR-5F_87RH2FpbsXupM3T8VYzdMw2e6LX0Tt6lic2W26lTjG8BFr4WJKhTSiqokpxQk7jhnDtfFI9Goof9BRkPynxwY1QHNKTmbxbROuXbS19OfRcvgKx)

---

Peter,

**$98 PER PERSON**
**As a former Navy SEAL** , I’m not intimidated by much. I’ve been around the world and fought on battlefields against enemy soldiers in hand-to-hand combat. As an aerial firefighter, **I’ve piloted planes through some of the most intense wildfires imaginable**.

While I’ve had some thrilling experiences, I’ve never feared the challenges that have been put before me - I assess each situation and determine how best to achieve the desired outcome with minimal harm to myself or to my team.

Last June 27th I declared my candidacy to be the next U.S. Senator for Montana - it was the first time in longer than I can remember that my new day job didn’t involve the risk of serious injury**or even death**. But just because I’m not putting myself in harm’s way at present,**I’m still in the line of fire.**

When I was deciding whether to challenge Jon Tester last spring, I did some digging to find out how much a U.S. Senate campaign costs and what I’d have to raise to be competitive against the last statewide elected Democrat. _**What I discovered shocked me. **_

**_OVER $70 MILLION WAS SPENT IN 2018 - AT THE TIME THE COSTLIEST FEDERAL RACE IN MONTANA’S HISTORY. CAMPAIGNS AND OUTSIDE SUPER PACS SPENT MORE THAN $98 PER PERSON TO INFLUENCE THEIR VOTE._ **

| | I've talked a lot the last two years since _Roe_ was overturned about the consequences that ruling would have for women and doctors nationwide. Since that day in 2022, we've read headline after headline about how women are being denied the care they need. But today I'm writing to tell you about another case currently before the Supreme Court that, if allowed to be upheld, would protect an Idaho state law that says that no doctor can perform an abortion in an emergency room **even if the woman's life is at risk**. Yes, you read that correctly: the state of Idaho is suing to let women die in emergency rooms instead of giving them the life-saving reproductive health care they need. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85089346/473617065/-2044921950?refcode=2024-05-16-id&recurring=&amount=7&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=1e33f129-c513-ef11-96f3-7c1e5214dad0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZTMzZjEyOS1jNTEzLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxNGRhZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Tlnzl-eprgsAUE4vo1SS5_LPh4SBf27L6ZEXAKHKVg8=) **A****lawyer representing Idaho during oral arguments even conceded that**** _organ failure_****would not in and of itself qualify someone for an abortion.** This also means that if a doctor decides to intervene and provide abortion care to save a woman's life, that doctor could face persecution for doing so, and that means women are going to die. Of course, under this Supreme Court – with 6 justices appointed by anti-choice Republican Presidents – there's every chance that Idaho's cruel abortion law is upheld. **It's a reminder of the painful reality America is in after**** _Dobbs_****.** If we're going to change it, we need to preserve and expand our Democratic Senate majority – allowing us to pass national abortion rights legislation that will undo cruel laws like the one in Idaho. You can see pictures from the last two months below — but first, I have to ask: As this race heats up, we’ll need your support to take on our Republican opponent and the special interests backing him. Can you chip in just a little to our grassroots campaign now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_051624_Recap_act]

In Congress, I’ll fight to make sure we can all build the lives we want for ourselves and our kids. I’ll protect reproductive rights, defend Arizona’s water supply, and invest in good jobs across our district.
This race is going to be tough, but we have the BEST people fighting for us. Thank you to all our supporters for making this possible.

name: Chris Murdock
subject: This is how we win. Gabby Salinas is our chance.
disclaimer_text: Paid for By Our Tennessee Future PAC, Not Affiliated with Any Candidate or Candidate Committee [contact us](mailto:info@ourtenn
body:
It is our job to support candidates who will shift the tide in Tennessee.

| | | | | [ ](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fourtenn.org%2F/1/010f018f83344b0e-dba8b3a0-9ada-42bd-94d2-22e65948d53e-000000/f92aW341SkpncguDVGlU1NdXFJs=159)
---
Dear Peter,
---
| | In the wake of recent events, it's become increasingly clear that the political landscape in Tennessee is shifting in alarming ways. Over the past few years, Republican-controlled initiatives have threatened the very fabric of our democratic values. But our hope is renewed when we see people like Gabby Salinas stepping up.

Former Shelby County Democratic Party chair Gabby Salinas has announced her candidacy for the state House seat left vacant by fellow Democrat Dwayne Thompson. Gabby's decision to run is fueled by her unwavering commitment to making Tennessee a better place for all its residents. She's a true champion for change and a beacon of hope for Tennessee.

[**She’s the kind of candidate we came together to support. Can you chip in now to make sure we have the resources to support candidates like Gabby all across Tennessee?**](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Four-tennessee-future-pac-1%3Frefcode=TENN_24_EM_8_Gabby_Salinas_New/1/010f018f83344b0e-dba8b3a0-9ada-42bd-94d2-22e65948d53e-000000/X1JgLGcHgKf0r07ZxIoDORSHZGs=159)
---
| [Donate](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Four-tennessee-future-pac-1%3Frefcode=TENN_24_EM_8_Gabby_Salinas_New/2/010f018f83344b0e-dba8b3a0-9ada-42bd-94d2-22e65948d53e-000000/xrRAJJH3AxAqeUhizNGoat6HbE4=159 "Donate")
---
Gabby's platform is all about putting people first. She's a passionate advocate for ensuring access to quality healthcare for all Tennesseans, funding our public schools, and standing up for the rights of marginalized communities. With her background as a cancer survivor and a scientist at St. Jude Children's Research Hospital, Gabby brings a unique perspective and a deep sense of empathy to the table.

Now, more than ever, we don’t just need Gabby Salinas in Nashville, we need a Democratic majority fighting for our values and representing the interests of everyday Tennesseans. But to make that happen, progressive candidates need our support.

Let's show the world what Tennessee is truly capable of. Together, we can build a brighter future for our state and create positive change that will benefit generations to come.
---
**Thank you** for your unwavering support and dedication to making Tennessee a better place for all.
---
In solidarity,
Chris Murdock
Our Tennessee Future PAC Team
---
| [Donate](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Four-tennessee-future-pac-1%3Frefcode=TENN_24_EM_8_Gabby_Salinas_New/3/010f018f83344b0e-dba8b3a0-9ada-42bd-94d2-22e65948d53e-000000/1waRC4q3RumNRKpDugAQt2NkvHo=159 "Donate")
---
_Our Tennessee Future PAC has been established as a proactive response to the political landscape in Tennessee, which has been taken over by MAGA ideologies. This PAC is dedicated to supporting state-elected officials who represent alternative, more progressive values contrary to those of the MAGA Republicans who currently dominate the state legislature. Key strategies include voter registration drives and targeted advertising campaigns, especially in districts where MAGA-aligned candidates are entrenched or pose a strong threat in upcoming elections. By mobilizing pro-Democratic voters and enhancing electoral participation, Our Tennessee Future PAC aims to effect substantial change and balance within Tennessee's political sphere, ensuring the state's policies and leadership accurately reflect the diverse perspectives of its residents. Your donation helps us in this fight.___

[**BREAKING NEWS: Supreme Court issues stay to keep Louisiana's Voting Rights Act-compliant congressional map in place**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85090757/473621660/-2004348825?refcode=don_aotl_redite_email_mayfun_email_20240516-AOTL-SCOTUSRR-EHH_&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg5NjYzMjQyLWM3MTMtZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjE0ZGFkMCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=T5i3aIvgtgWuGikOkHVzJGWrU9y9XHILeDfA5NHHofo=)
Team,
The Voting Rights Act, the crown jewel of the Civil Rights Movement, remains absolutely necessary to protect the constitutional rights of the American people, particularly communities of color.
With yesterday’s stay, the U.S. Supreme Court has acted in a manner that is consistent with its decision last year in _Allen v. Milligan_ in making real the power of Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act.
**This is an unequivocal victory for Black Louisianians** , who have fought tenaciously for the equal representation they deserve as American citizens. The state, consistent with the law, will now have a second Black opportunity district in its congressional map this fall.
**It is also a clear message to those who intend to gerrymander in order to increase their illegitimate power at the expense of voters of color:__you will be stopped.__**

The state, consistent with the law, will now have a second Black opportunity district in its congressional map this fall. * Does the person understand the basics of leadership – honesty, morality, empathy, and coalition building?
* Has the person accomplished something through volunteer work or prior elected experience to know what hard work means,
* When they have disagreed with me or others, have they picked up the phone to let me or others know why they don't agree and then worked to negotiate a better plan for all?
* Does the person represent progressive values, full stop?

body:
Friend, it’s official: I just won the Maryland U.S. Senate Democratic primary and will be taking on Republican Larry Hogan in November.

Make no mistake, Larry Hogan won’t be easy to beat. He was handpicked by Mitch McConnell and his MAGA allies have already started pouring in millions of dollars to defeat me.

The GOP’s plan to take back the Senate majority hinges on Maryland. That’s why I need your help stopping them starting right now.

My team has a 10,000 General Election Founding Donor Goal that we must hit within the next week to have the resources to start the general on the right foot. Will you chip in a split grassroots donation of $5 right now between my campaign and Jacky Rosen to become a General Election Founding Donor?

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rosenfornevada_maryland?refcode=jtk3858-bu-text&amounts=250,100,50,25,5

As Prince George’s County Executive and a former state’s attorney, I’ve spent my career fighting on behalf of Maryland families. In the Senate, I’ll be a strong voice in support of abortion rights, equality, education, and economic opportunity.

But, my Republican opponent Larry Hogan? He’s working against our Maryland values.

As Governor, he vetoed a $15 minimum wage, common sense gun legislation, and access to increased reproductive and abortion care in Maryland.

On the campaign trail, he has continually flip-flopped on the issues because he’s afraid to stand up to his party. He’s even called access to reproductive care an “emotional issue for women.”

The simple truth is this: Mitch McConnell is banking on flipping this seat and using Hogan’s vote to pass a national abortion ban, destroy Social Security and Medicare, and give tax breaks to MAGA big money donors.

I look forward to making sure every Maryland voter knows just how dangerous Larry Hogan would be in the U.S. Senate. But, we need resources ASAP to start putting his feet to the fire.

We just have 6 months to win this race, so we need your help ASAP. Will you split a donation of $5 between Jacky Rosen and my campaign to become a General Election Founding Donor and defeat Republican Larry Hogan in November?

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rosenfornevada_maryland?refcode=jtk3858-bu-text&amounts=250,100,50,25,5

Thanks for your support,

Angela Alsobrooks

**MEMORANDUM** **TO:** Grassroots Donors
**FROM:** DNC Chair Jaime Harrison
**RE:** Six Months Out, the DNC is Strong -- and Only Getting Stronger In 2024, the DNC is continuing its winning streak at the ballot box by spearheading efforts to elect Democrats up and down the ballot, from local office to the Oval Office. And because we've started earlier than ever before, those efforts are already paying dividends. Thanks to the hard work and commitment of the President and Vice President, our candidates, our volunteers and donors, and our staff, the DNC and state parties across the country have marshalled historic resources and built sustainable infrastructure that's notched wins up and down the ballot. And we're going to do it again in November. Meanwhile, Donald Trump's MAGA extremism has taken over the Republican Party, and it's been a disaster for his campaign, the RNC, and GOP state parties from Michigan to Arizona. At this point, state Republicans are better known for their financial problems and infighting than mobilizing voters. Hi there, it’s the team at the Jane Fonda Climate PAC. During a recent all-team call, we realized that most of us are avid podcast listeners, and we couldn’t stop talking about one episode in particular... _The Daily_ ’s May 7th climate episode, which made a stark revelation about our planet's health: **Our oceans are warming at rates that could soon reach a catastrophic tipping point.** We all agree this episode is a must-listen for anyone who cares about the climate crisis, but if you’re short on time, here’s the gist: As ocean temperatures rise, coral reefs — the very foundation of marine biodiversity — are experiencing bleaching at alarming rates, disrupting ecosystems and the marine life that depend on them. Coral reefs not only protect coastlines from the erosive forces of waves and storms, they’re a lifeline for local economies — contributing hundreds of millions of dollars to businesses and providing countless jobs through fishing, diving, and snorkeling. Not to mention, coral reefs are a vital food source and a treasure trove for medical research, offering prospects for new medicines that could cure diseases like cancer. What’s more, this unprecedented warming is setting the stage for what could be a historic hurricane season this year. The season is set to begin on June 1, and there’s no telling the scale of damage hurricanes could inflict on communities across the country, but this is also a clear environmental justice issue. Gulf cities, home to large communities of color, are often hit hardest by hurricanes. As the threat of hurricanes grows, these communities, already burdened by pollution and high levels of poverty, face new dangers they are ill-equipped to manage. But the scariest part of the whole podcast was about the effects of global warming on the Greenland ice sheet. Scientists believe it could lead to a complete collapse of the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC). AMOC plays a huge role in regulating the weather and climate across the globe. If AMOC collapses, everything we know about life on Earth could change. The last time something like this happened was almost 13,000 years ago, and we were plunged into an Ice Age where we lost entire civilizations. **Our mission at Jane PAC has never been clearer or more urgent. We need to do everything in our power to support and elect leaders who are aware of these urgent challenges and prepared to take bold actions to address them. We must advocate for policies that protect our oceans, reduce global carbon emissions, and ensure our planet remains a livable home for future generations.** We are at a pivotal moment where our actions can either tip the scales toward recovery or complete disaster. **[We’re asking you to choose action today and support Jane PAC with a donation of any amount. body:
The way Fox hosts talk, you would have no idea that homicides are falling to historic lows across the country.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240516-1&t=1&akid=697%2E587540%2EccXkXZ)
Peter, I was unfortunate enough to catch a few seconds of a Fox News broadcast the other day, and I was a little surprised how much they were fear mongering about supposedly unprecedented levels of crime.
**The way they were talking, you would have no idea that homicides are falling to historic lows across the country:**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240516-1?refcode=em20240516-1&amount=5&refcode2=697_587540_ccXkXZ&akid=697%2E587540%2EccXkXZ)
Crazy idea — MAYBE it has to do with the first gun law passed in 30 years Biden signed in 2022. The Safer Communities Act has put billions into preventing gun violence and expanded background checks for those under 21 buying a gun.
Fox has the largest news audience on cable TV, and they’re feeding straight up lies to their viewers on an hourly basis.
They’re not taking a kernel of truth and exaggerating it — **they’re telling up-is-down, left-is-right _lies_.** And they reach millions and millions of voters each day.
So that’s what we’re up against, Peter. If we want to get more young people elected who will solve real problems instead of screaming about fake ones, and who work on actually solving problems, not just campaigning on them — we need to be prepared to fight back against the propaganda machine that is Fox News and the rest of the right-wing media. These younger candidates who will long outlive Trump and hopefully his fake news machine offer us the best shot of turning our country around long term.

David Hogg

Friend, **Another ceasefire candidate needs our support.** Susheela Jayapal―the sister of Congresswoman Pramila Jayapal, who chairs the Congressional Progressive Caucus―is running for an open congressional seat in Oregon. **Up against millions of dollars in spending from anti-Palestinian group AIPAC and its affiliated PACs and Republican donors, Susheela has called for a ceasefire since last fall and she supports conditioning U.S. military funding to Israel based on human rights standards.** In addition to running attack ads against Susheela, AIPAC-aligned donors helped raise her Democratic primary opponent nearly $220,000 just last week in the homestretch of their primary election. As Ryan Grim from The Intercept reports:****_“The last-minute deluge from Republican and AIPAC donors ... has upended the open primary race.”_ As most of my colleagues in Congress continue to send billions to help the apartheid Israeli government commit genocide against the Palestinian people, I need more allies like Susheela by my side in Congress demanding a ceasefire and pushing to invest in our communities’ fundamental rights to housing, healthcare, and more. Democrats love to put minorities in their little boxes.

They say that we can’t succeed without the government’s help. They say we need “special treatment” to get ahead in life.

**Well, I’m here to call them out on their B.S.**

My name is CAPT Hung Cao. I’m a Vietnamese-American LEGAL immigrant and a 25-year Navy Combat veteran. I didn’t get my appointment to the Naval Academy or my job leading my special operations team all over the world because I was a minority - I did it because I proved myself and worked hard.

**I’ll say the hard part out loud: the Democrats’ woke agenda is nothing but racism, and I’m on a mission to stop it.**

Now, I’m running for U.S. Senate because I believe ALL Americans have the capacity for greatness, no matter the color of their skin.

**[If you’re ready to bring REAL equality back to America, I want you on my team. Will you pitch in now to fuel our fight?](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=3685bc2ec6d54663946c58f09afc9185&_e=Mdd905_IssANhuUpZF6nXOeB2OewnzO6G0uRGiXmiv7wm30-hBXe26WXXFnvI3Uf-_gNH-bw3lgot6IBOpTYE7IhTr7IDOb57J_Kd4OiLJr4ICTJIzuane2j9BM2qWh0katF8pstfJMiH8iV9vBfN49vmuv8rmctyGpuaKGvTRtXBz1c5vhq45RK1bzLIUdxmcvz0gD4Dya50KeG_cyS2dVUlVJ2tJ6evDi_uRmbmghSWRb1jzLgDxnMisFMDXYUqB-pjxafYMtmj-VnEDVj6Oov31AGJDWJVf6kVcR24OM%3D)**
---
[**FUEL OUR FIGHT**](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=3685bc2ec6d54663946c58f09afc9185&_e=Mdd905_IssANhuUpZF6nXOeB2OewnzO6G0uRGiXmiv7wm30-hBXe26WXXFnvI3Uf-_gNH-bw3lgot6IBOpTYE7IhTr7IDOb57J_Kd4OiLJr4ICTJIzuane2j9BM2qWh0katF8pstfJMiH8iV9vBfN9zqiDKsTBCPd9vmbtzZuhcLQx_mXce0cfWf2Ki1HIZ6yJHzi_cyCuhQf82BOGwDPP0v1jPhzq9Eje-8PWwmbBYAAbLL62fx5YNucavMu_8_Emw9XWUFiJjqj6Oslc_XpqjPmiIgVmmOFnDurNY_e3w%3D)
---
When I served in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia, I didn’t care what the men and women serving alongside me looked like.

I only cared that they were ready to do their jobs to keep our country safe.

But today’s Democrats would rather put our national security at risk than accept that race doesn’t matter.

_It’s almost like they know they can never win on their own merits, so they’re working to divide us and make us easier to control._

I won’t stand for the lies.

**[I’m proud of where I’ve gotten in life and my service to our country, and I will NEVER let a woke Democrat tell me I only got there because I’m a minority. If you’re sick of the woke agenda, stand with me today.](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=3685bc2ec6d54663946c58f09afc9185&_e=Mdd905_IssANhuUpZF6nXOeB2OewnzO6G0uRGiXmiv7wm30-hBXe26WXXFnvI3Uf-_gNH-bw3lgot6IBOpTYE7IhTr7IDOb57J_Kd4OiLJr4ICTJIzuane2j9BM2qWh0katF8pstfJMiH8iV9vBfN5U0ZdX38Llmm1eM-SkUwTs_HLn564ZCirY__6xaT5nUMCxx050d__FX9s71098fKWh26LeFQC4M4grOFY-MgtqgFOYLXUKNCNL9Xp3Nu_T_MCxikvvn0VyW3eWqb5KaGRrDsPULcaL1MobXJ0g75yA%3D)**

**$98 PER PERSON**
**As a former Navy SEAL** , I’m not intimidated by much. I’ve been around the world and fought on battlefields against enemy soldiers in hand-to-hand combat. As an aerial firefighter, **I’ve piloted planes through some of the most intense wildfires imaginable**.

While I’ve had some thrilling experiences, I’ve never feared the challenges that have been put before me - I assess each situation and determine how best to achieve the desired outcome with minimal harm to myself or to my team.

Last June 27th I declared my candidacy to be the next U.S. Senator for Montana - it was the first time in longer than I can remember that my new day job didn’t involve the risk of serious injury**or even death**. But just because I’m not putting myself in harm’s way at present,**I’m still in the line of fire.**

The Biden-Harris administration is delivering on a major campaign promise. **The DEA is poised to reclassify cannabis as a Schedule III drug, and President Biden just announced his support.**
This means weed will no longer be lumped in with heroin and ecstasy as a highly addictive, dangerous drug. Instead, it will join Tylenol with codeine and testosterone in Schedule III where potential penalties for possessing it can be much lower.

Friend,

**Three years ago, the Spirit of Virginia was asleep.**

Our great Commonwealth was falling behind under extreme, failed policies that made the cost of living unaffordable, kept parents out of their children's lives, and forced people to move away from Virginia.

But then something amazing happened. In 2021, the Spirit of Virginia woke back up. Virginians across the political divide made a decision to change direction and we haven't looked back since.

We went from the bottom of the country in job growth to near the top of the list. Virginians are keeping more of their hard-earned money, and we're lowering the cost of living. Parents are back in control of their children's education and upbringing.

Our teachers and law enforcement are getting the pay and support they deserve. We're transforming our behavioral health system to get Virginians the right help right now.

We're proving that commonsense, conservative leadership works.

_And now, the Spirit of Virginia is stronger than ever before._

But [we have a lot more work](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=e600b77996844d17ad5afef89ee7e006&_e=OQHUc8TdFgdfu0DQ3Ip6iVyCAah7h7AncZjsWKUuxaIwGONHmNIQkbSYwPHM-T6sLOI2yDmVyFcQaV8undNDg-O4ijyAknwyIjUYdOKuWNlXkTZaB7ZMCAHfTmvUP2vz-u_QwKH90J-atwsATAjHR4Hd7AkxoJvAQpEUtC4pFIKfjmZCZvEYuPoGoyAeWqtxjZPM7RoY3CpQxUB8RGHegNXTWNqBUog_YRiNrHyajxXSV7YskNnl6RCL0YRmgsB7qapI02yLHS8_EvAd8naXHZA96Qfg41wlUE9OGDNkhWtAESPykZeeXEhb58wPW1c3OYsFkA8pcH3-XnpelAzBi8sIPdhTd4irHbxJQ4lsGtzxTTP1qIYINHXqhOoZCOKt7x7G9ooWZNA1kDORBGDnjg%3D%3D) to do. ICYMI, Friend, President Trump and I agree- we must take action to secure America's elections. As it stands, states are **FORBIDDEN** from asking for proof of citizenship when registering new voters. That means that non-citizens can illegally register to vote in our elections **RIGHT NOW**. What's more: It's nearly impossible to track how many non-citizens are voting or where it's happening - which means that ineligible voters could be diluting the voting power of law-abiding citizens like you and me. **[That's not acceptable, Friend. body:
Do you know how much political campaigns will spend to win a vote? | [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=22d3c416295f4064908dc9f853bb7f29&_e=dq56lg6vLP0_UL2rl3BY8ALFAJRtTjehNLxA5XwEWzK1vuMPd6FHGkqzQopT5uMRDy6paBniWrEoc45Q6IfECI9ZDKEMmEKK5lRA_vTqMbF4FXlDoU3imVm9QJ5VcPOaorrIAfTuWEiMTjNYCq7rYHnkBw7m-1jzp910kH4_dL_rAT8KlVJNh0MZaNqfhRX0LQtAO6aTMb_ehN50_prwkCHsVFVJi94nHXvyrBJPukQqzDBZSLIg5-al5sOMEjmgHmxCmNrmPCWxU93BmUeHajhtDQhS7Vk8Q9H0_KPLnHYEbhFU2Uk_QirZGXmFtCiDO-FPkj0Hi2AhgH0wTyI46zcrW--3oYsXN5nGKjFYDy-KJ9c7sqWozsWyE8s-EzmZ)

---

Peter,

**$98 PER PERSON**
**As a former Navy SEAL** , I’m not intimidated by much. I’ve been around the world and fought on battlefields against enemy soldiers in hand-to-hand combat. As an aerial firefighter, **I’ve piloted planes through some of the most intense wildfires imaginable**.

While I’ve had some thrilling experiences, I’ve never feared the challenges that have been put before me - I assess each situation and determine how best to achieve the desired outcome with minimal harm to myself or to my team.

Last June 27th I declared my candidacy to be the next U.S. Senator for Montana - it was the first time in longer than I can remember that my new day job didn’t involve the risk of serious injury**or even death**. But just because I’m not putting myself in harm’s way at present,**I’m still in the line of fire.**

When I was deciding whether to challenge Jon Tester last spring, I did some digging to find out how much a U.S. Senate campaign costs and what I’d have to raise to be competitive against the last statewide elected Democrat. _**What I discovered shocked me. **_

**_OVER $70 MILLION WAS SPENT IN 2018 - AT THE TIME THE COSTLIEST FEDERAL RACE IN MONTANA’S HISTORY. CAMPAIGNS AND OUTSIDE SUPER PACS SPENT MORE THAN $98 PER PERSON TO INFLUENCE THEIR VOTE._ **

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=22d3c416295f4064908dc9f853bb7f29&_e=dq56lg6vLP0_UL2rl3BY8ALFAJRtTjehNLxA5XwEWzK1vuMPd6FHGkqzQopT5uMRDy6paBniWrEoc45Q6IfECI9ZDKEMmEKK5lRA_vTqMbF4FXlDoU3imVm9QJ5VcPOaorrIAfTuWEiMTjNYCq7rYHnkBw7m-1jzp910kH4_dL_rAT8KlVJNh0MZaNqfhRX0LQtAO6aTMb_ehN50_prwkCHsVFVJi94nHXvyrBJPukR6hqGSEhKk32yzwaoldCPmzl-YeO1gNGhoY9H9dmDT_crzbquYLjJcJTQYzClmDbDRz2fYcbu71xsgoE74JM3ZBRjLa5FlUBzR62jyt2Ivw7qZCqdT9_TrJr7PwPKaJHt_UAnXf6m-9vZOMB3FR2wE)
Given that my opponent raised more than $20 million last year **the 2018 record won’t stand.**

While I’m not scared of the task ahead of me, **it is daunting to imagine raising the money I’ll need to successfully win this election.** By some estimates that sum will be more than $100 million dollars.

I know we’re not going to raise the money we need all at once - or even in a year’s time. What I do know is that we will raise it. We’re setting goals each day - and **[if we continue to hit them, we’ll eventually get to where we need to be](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=22d3c416295f4064908dc9f853bb7f29&_e=dq56lg6vLP0_UL2rl3BY8ALFAJRtTjehNLxA5XwEWzK1vuMPd6FHGkqzQopT5uMRDy6paBniWrEoc45Q6IfECI9ZDKEMmEKK5lRA_vTqMbF4FXlDoU3imVm9QJ5VcPOaorrIAfTuWEiMTjNYCq7rYHnkBw7m-1jzp910kH4_dL_rAT8KlVJNh0MZaNqfhRX0LQtAO6aTMb_ehN50_prwkCHsVFVJi94nHXvyrBJPukTxuXOVP06POxHLsI5SiW1m4dL1z_y96j2ogjcaG62IRerO99HK95OTZmxbIL1l2PIANPCy2OJAbXNtQKfBizZzWfc2m6_hnGlVvM8XP1tUZPAw-o9ymvmkRUYwoMftAEU40Q6XBPG4vwrdWhqJqSz8)**.

**[I’m coming to you today to let you know that we’re aiming to raise $999 today](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=22d3c416295f4064908dc9f853bb7f29&_e=dq56lg6vLP0_UL2rl3BY8ALFAJRtTjehNLxA5XwEWzK1vuMPd6FHGkqzQopT5uMRDy6paBniWrEoc45Q6IfECI9ZDKEMmEKK5lRA_vTqMbF4FXlDoU3imVm9QJ5VcPOaorrIAfTuWEiMTjNYCq7rYHnkBw7m-1jzp910kH4_dL_rAT8KlVJNh0MZaNqfhRX0LQtAO6aTMb_ehN50_prwkCHsVFVJi94nHXvyrBJPukSO0sXVrq8gKFOoQ8WLpvtnnMAl6kVLGkRglwGPREAPUIMsPNlCfB4lVoQr3WCREKocVOK8iY6xZ-MAiiIhi-NytyN-T6Bldw591ilrFTo8n_IZ4GD4998f1osjMNnZ3otCR3T7fWJxcov2PY3fiR1Z)**.

clean_body: Do you know how much political campaigns will spend to win a vote? | Peter, $98 PER PERSON As a former Navy SEAL , I’m not intimidated by much. I’ve been around the world and fought on battlefields against enemy soldiers in hand-to-hand combat. As an aerial firefighter, I’ve piloted planes through some of the most intense wildfires imaginable. While I’ve had some thrilling experiences, I’ve never feared the challenges that have been put before me - I assess each situation and determine how best to achieve the desired outcome with minimal harm to myself or to my team. Last June 27th I declared my candidacy to be the next U.S. Senator for Montana - it was the first time in longer than I can remember that my new day job didn’t involve the risk of serious injuryor even death. But just because I’m not putting myself in harm’s way at present,I’m still in the line of fire. When I was deciding whether to challenge Jon Tester last spring, I did some digging to find out how much a U.S. Senate campaign costs and what I’d have to raise to be competitive against the last statewide elected Democrat. What I discovered shocked me. OVER $70 MILLION WAS SPENT IN 2018 - AT THE TIME THE COSTLIEST FEDERAL RACE IN MONTANA’S HISTORY. CAMPAIGNS AND OUTSIDE SUPER PACS SPENT MORE THAN $98 PER PERSON TO INFLUENCE THEIR VOTE. Given that my opponent raised more than $20 million last year the 2018 record won’t stand. While I’m not scared of the task ahead of me, it is daunting to imagine raising the money I’ll need to successfully win this election. By some estimates that sum will be more than $100 million dollars. I know we’re not going to raise the money we need all at once - or even in a year’s time. What I do know is that we will raise it. subject: Add your name: Bernie - "Israel has broken international law. It has broken American law. And in my view, Israel should not be receiving another nickel in U.S. military aid"
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Our Revolution click here to unsubscribe
body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis — Republicans
and some Democrats in Congress are continuing to push for unconditional,
no-questions-asked military support for Israel.

It doesn’t seem to matter to them that Netanyahu’s regime has killed over
30,000 Palestinians and 200 aid workers. It doesn’t seem like they care
that Israel has used U.S. taxpayer funding and American-made weapons to
block humanitarian aid to Gaza so over one million people face starvation
(including hundreds of thousands of children).

Bernie and other pro-Peace progressives care and are advocating for
action. The fight continues to block more U.S. support for Netanyahu’s
atrocities.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17774?t=1011&akid=6004%2E5885482%2Ejle49j ][IMG]

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17773?source=email-20240516&t=1012&akid=6004%2E5885482%2Ejle49j ]Add your name: Not another nickel, and not another American-made bomb,
for Netanyahu’s war on Gaza. Biden must use his power to end the
atrocities against the Palestinian people.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17773?source=email-20240516&t=1013&akid=6004%2E5885482%2Ejle49j ]ADD YOUR NAME

First, Biden paused offensive weapons shipments to Israel — but only
certain weapons. Then, when Congress said it wanted to restart
unconditional military support for Israel, Biden tried to appease them by
authorizing another $1 billion arms sale to Netanyahu. Are Biden’s actions
about real policy change or PR stunts and misdirections?

President Biden needs to do more, and he needs to listen to Bernie, who
has been calling on the Biden administration and Congress to stop
supporting these atrocities for months. We need a permanent Ceasefire and
an end to unconditional U.S. support and the horrific U.S. complicity in
the violence in Gaza.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/17773?source=email-20240516&t=1014&akid=6004%2E5885482%2Ejle49j ]Add your name: End U.S. support for Netanyahu’s atrocities!

clean_body: Plus: Yurok leader talks land return | May 16, 2024 | California State Parks Week Grab your friends and family and choose from more than 200 special events—most of them free—at state parks across California. Check out our list of the best redwood park activities, from stargazing to birding to guided hikes and more. Q&A Rosie Clayburn shares insights on the future transfer of ‘O Rew Redwoods Gateway to the Yurok Tribe, plus the importance of shaping the visitor experience on ancestral land. “We have seen what happens when we are not interpreting our culture, when we are not the ones telling our story.” Policy New policies from Washington, DC, and Sacramento put protected lands front and center in plans to ramp up climate resilience. See what these changes could mean for our redwood forests. Podcast Season Four of the League’s I’ll Go If You Go podcast kicks off with an exploration of jobs in the redwood forest. Listen as Francisco Saavedra shares his experience as a Redwoods Rising apprentice and what he hopes to accomplish as an “Indigenous ecological warrior.” Behind the scenes California’s state conservatories funnel millions of bond dollars toward public beaches, hiking trails, fishing streams, and redwoods parks. But now they’re running out of money. Find out how proposed legislation could turn the tide—and why your voice matters. | | Instagram Post of the Month ---|--- | | ---|--- Join us May 18 at our Take Me to the Trees celebration and raise a glass of Fogbelt Brewing Co’s special edition beer, brewed with redwood tips! 🍻🌿 📷 @fogbeltbrewing THE LEAGUE IN THE NEWS San Francisco Chronicle The Mercury News Support our work Connect with us | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- | | Save the Redwoods League 111 Sutter Street, 11th Floor San Francisco, CA 94104 United States |

name: Sarah McBride
subject: A 34% slowdown
body:
My team just let me know...
#
Hi, it’s Sarah.
Even as folks have stepped up to support our campaign this month, my team just let me know that:
1) Our email fundraising is **34%** lower than it was in April.
2) We still need to raise **$3,201** before midnight to get back on track to reaching our May fundraising goal.
[**As one of my top supporters, will you consider making an urgent donation to help us catch up? If 128 people pitch in just $25, we’ll close the gap.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240516-1?refcode=em20240516-1-416&refcode2=416_21716_bsvHtC&akid=416%2E21716%2EbsvHtC)
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240516-1?refcode=em20240516-1-416&refcode2=416_21716_bsvHtC&akid=416%2E21716%2EbsvHtC)**
**This seat will represent Delaware at large, and it takes a lot of resources to reach voters across the state at their doorsteps, on their phones, on TV, and online.**
45% of voters are undecided in this race, so we’re making big financial investments right now. And with just over 15 weeks left until our primary, we can’t afford a drop in our fundraising.
I’m so grateful for your support — but since I count on grassroots supporters pitching in what they can, wherever they can, to fund our campaign, **it’d mean so much to me if you could help us reach our goal right now.**
[**If you can, please make a contribution right now.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240516-1?refcode=em20240516-1-416&refcode2=416_21716_bsvHtC&akid=416%2E21716%2EbsvHtC)

Together, we’ll prove small states can do big things.
Thank you so much,
Sarah McBride

# Combatting Christian Nationalism
---
| [ ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/maga-os?refcode=2025)
---
We've witnessed Christian nationalists infiltrating our political system, with many of them present during the events of January 6th. These individuals, under the guise of faith, have resorted to violence, attacking fellow Americans, causing harm to law enforcement officers, and even threatening elected officials. Christian nationalists have been instrumental in pushing forward regressive agendas, such as the anti-abortion movement, which seeks to dismantle crucial rights like those protected by Roe v. Wade. Their influence, especially within the Supreme Court, poses a significant threat to reproductive freedom, disregarding even cases of rape and incest. Beyond social issues, Christian nationalists are now targeting the very foundations of our democracy. They're attacking our education system and attempting to distort the founding principles of our nation, particularly those that uphold freedom of religion. It's crucial to recognize that this is not merely a religious issue; it's a threat to our democracy and the values we hold dear. Regardless of religious beliefs, we can all agree on the importance of compassion and empathy, as epitomized by the principle of "love thy neighbor." Christian nationalism is a dangerous distortion of faith, used to consolidate power and promote self-interest. We cannot allow it to continue unchecked. It's imperative that we unite to push back against this harmful ideology and safeguard the principles of equality, freedom, and justice for all. Together, we can stand up against Christian nationalism and protect the values that define us as a nation. [**Join us in this critical battle to protect our nation from Trump’s authoritarian ambitions. Together, we can preserve the very essence of American democracy. Time is of the essence—your immediate action is crucial.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/maga-os?refcode=2025)

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: re: The Supreme Court and the CFPB
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
The Little Agency That Could will live to fight another day.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2176%2E4032634%2E_SLTfj)
---
Did you see today’s breaking news? **The Supreme Court followed the law and upheld the constitutionality of the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau’s funding structure — so the “Little Agency That Could” will live to fight another day.** Look: I’m not surprised that the CFPB faced this attack, which its opponents have been trotting out for years and years and years. When you have an agency that is this good at protecting consumers, then of course a lot of big banks, a lot of payday lenders, and a lot of Republican politicians will go after it and try to shut it down. We can all let out a sigh of relief that the CFPB overcame this threat — just like we had to overcome armies of Wall Street lobbyists to get it into law in the first place. **But I wanted to share three thoughts on what led to today’s ruling and what could come next:**
1. The fact that this particular case — which had no basis in law — made it all the way up to the Supreme Court is a reminder of just how extreme some of our lower federal courts have become.
2. We’re not fooling ourselves: the CFPB’s opponents will come back on the attack. After all, this agency has put over $20 billion back in the pockets of seniors, students, service members, veterans, families struggling to make it to the end of the month, and other consumers who got cheated by financial institutions — so those financial institutions have over 20 billion reasons to want to knock it out the game for good.
3. And there’s still a pending case before the Supreme Court that could gut the ability of all federal agencies to do their jobs on behalf of working people.

So we know the threats that we still face. We know that those forces have got plenty of money and power, and that they’ll keep fighting. _But so will we_. And we’ve got our passion, we’ve got our determination, and we’ve got a consumer agency that is still protecting the American people. We’ll keep having the CFPB’s back, and we’ll stay in this fight. No matter what. [**If you’re able to make a donation of $28 or any amount right now to help make sure our government works not just for big banks but for all Americans, then please pitch in and help power the fight.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2209?amount=28&t=8&akid=2176%2E4032634%2E_SLTfj) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

But after John Lee trashed President Trump and veterans, the decision was easy. Peter, it was a UNANIMOUS Decision. | | Mail in ballots have just been shipped out. Please vote by June 11th for the Republican Patriot in this race DAVID FLIPPO. | Nye County GOP Chairman shared these words in support: On behalf of the Nye County Republican Central Committee, the official Republican Party of Nye County; and as its Chairman, I am proud to speak in support of Lieutenant Colonel David Flippo for Congress. Lt.Col Flippo has an incredible background of service to this country. He shares in our mission to support President Trump’s plan to save America and will be a great ally to Governor Lombardo’s Nevada Way agenda. He is strong on guns, crime, and securing our border. Flippo is a Constitutional conservative, we believe Flippo will flip this seat red and defeat Steve Horsford in November. David Flippo has our COMPLETE and TOTAL endorsement! | "Support the Republican Choice for NV-04" | | All For Our Country, | Noah Ameur Political Director Committee to Elect David Flippo | | | | | | | | | | | | "Paid for by The Committee To Elect David Flippo" | | Copyright © 2024 Committee To Elect David Flippo, All rights reserved.
